title: Desenvolvedor SAP ABAP
description:

Modelo de atuação: Remoto

Tipo de contratação: PJ ou Cooperado

  • Experiência com CDS Views
  • Vivência em projetos SAP S/4HANA
  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento orientado a objetos (ABAP OO)

Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento em Clean Core
  • Experiência com ABAP Cloud
  • Vivência com Fiori/UI5
  • Experiência com BTP (Business Technology Platform)

title: Médico Endocrinologista
description:
*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO ENDOCRINOLOGISTA NA TELADOC HEALTH\"


Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!


A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicas e Médicos Especialistas em Endocrinologia! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.


*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *


A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.


*O QUE PROCURAMOS: *


Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na modalidade de consultas de especialidade em Endocrinologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;


DESCRIÇÃO DAS ATIVIDADES:



  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Endocrinologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.


  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endocrinológicos .


  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade em Endocrinologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças Endocrinológicas .


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em Endocrinologia.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.


  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.


  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.


  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.


  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.


  • Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.


  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.


REQUISITOS


Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM ENDOCRINOLOGIA, concluída ou em andamento.


Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Título de Especialista - RQE (emitido pelo Conselho respectivo) em Endocrinologia, ou comprovante de matrícula em Residência, Pós Graduação, Especialização em Endocrinologia.
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil).


Experiência:

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Endocrinologia , sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;


Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endócrinos e metabólicos..


Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.


Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.


Local de Trabalho:

REMOTO



IMPORTANTE:


MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo.


REMUNERAÇÃO E AGENDAMENTOS : a negociar durante processo seletivo.


Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente em Endocrinologia.

title: Associate Account Executive - Biopharma
description:
JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as AbbVie, Astrazeneca, Pfizer, Merck. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


Our Biopharma team is growing, and we are looking for an experienced Associate Account Executive to expand institutional sales of our scientific video journal and databases to biopharma companies in North America. If you are ambitious, results-driven, and can develop relationships with scientists and progress opportunities, this position could be an excellent opportunity for you.


Responsibilities:


  • Own the full sales cycle, from prospecting to closing business for assigned biopharma accounts.
  • Conduct active outreach to build and progress opportunities in the pipeline to meet or exceed sales goals.
  • Build and execute a persistent outbound sales strategy, including cold calls and emails, to generate interest and accelerate new business generation.
  • Establish and maintain strong and professional relationships with biopharma librarians, R&D leadership and stakeholders.
  • Work with the marketing and customer success teams to customize marketing activities & provide support for each account.


Requirements:


  • A bachelor's degree
  • 2+ years of direct selling experience to stakeholders in the pharmaceutical, biotech, device, or healthcare industry.
  • Demonstrated success in meeting and exceeding sales objectives.
  • Proven ability to influence decision-makers and manage a full sales cycle.
  • Highly effective verbal and written communication skills.
  • A disciplined approach to daily activity planning, setting goals, and achieving success.
  • Experience with Salesforce or relevant sales CRM, MS Office is required.


Why Join JoVE?


  • A competitive compensation package, including unlimited commissions.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and productivity.
  • Opportunity to work in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
About

Flatiron is a global remote software development company with engineers located around the world. We unite experts from diverse backgrounds and experiences in a collaborative culture to deliver exceptional products and services for our clients. As a forward-thinking software engineering company, we provide industry-leading solutions to complex problems in both the US and the UK. Operating in a fast-paced, agile environment, we specialize in software consulting for our clients. We offer a stimulating and rewarding environment for our team members. We value innovation, continuous learning, and professional growth, and we strive to create a workplace where everyone can thrive. Join us at Flatiron and be a part of a team that is shaping the future of software development.


Job Summary

This is a full-time fully remote working opportunity where you will be working as part of a Scrum team which requires working closely with other software engineers, stakeholders and contributors on the project. Working with respect to the US timezone is a requirement for the position. Attending meetings, being actively involved in the decision making process and collaborating with all of these stakeholders are essential parts of this position.


Responsibilities

  • Design and implement scalable, high-performance full stack applications with a strong emphasis on backend architecture.
  • Lead and contribute to the integration of AI/ML features into products, collaborating closely with data scientists and engineers.
  • Develop robust backend services and APIs using Python or Node.js (Express, NestJS) .
  • Contribute to frontend development using React and modern JavaScript/TypeScript practices.
  • Identify, prioritize, and execute tasks throughout the software development lifecycle.
  • Debug, optimize, and maintain backend systems, APIs, and data workflows.
  • Ensure code quality through testing, code reviews, and best engineering practices.
  • Document development phases, monitor system performance, and improve reliability.
  • Participate in Scrum meetings and contribute to product and technical decision-making.


Qualifications

  • Higher education in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, ideally with a focus on Artificial Intelligence and/or Machine Learning
  • Advanced level of written and oral English proficiency.
  • 4+ years of professional software development experience, with strong backend expertise in Python and/or Node.js.
  • Proficiency with frontend technologies such as React, Next.js, and TypeScript .
  • Hands-on experience deploying ML/AI models into production environments.
  • Familiarity with database technologies such as MySQL, MongoDB, or PostgreSQL.
  • Strong understanding of Object-Oriented Programming, Agile development principles, and cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
  • Interest in applied AI and automation-driven development.


Benefits

  • Yearly Office Allowance Budget
  • Macbook Purchase Support
  • Wellbeing Support


If you are a good fit for the position, please apply through LinkedIn.

We only accept CVs that are in English.


Flatiron has a zero tolerance to discrimination policy. In this regard, during the course of the evaluation of your job application and all your employment relation, if any, all discriminatory factors such as race, sex, sexual orientation, social gender definitions/roles, color, national or social background, ethnicity, religion, age, disablement, political opinion or any status that is protected under law shall be disregarded.

title: Workday Adaptive Planning Consultant
description:
Job Summary

Client is seeking a senior-level Workday Adaptive Planning Consultant to lead the architecture, design, and build of complex planning solutions. This individual will be a hands-on consultant responsible for developing scalable planning models, supporting integrations across Adaptive Planning and Oracle platforms, and partnering with Finance, RevOps, Data, and IT teams to deliver business-critical planning capabilities. The ideal candidate will bring deep Adaptive Planning expertise, strong financial planning knowledge, and the ability to translate business requirements into high-impact system solutions.


Key Responsibilities

  • Architect, design, and build scalable planning models in Workday Adaptive Planning
  • Develop and optimize complex models including dimensions, sheets, versions, assumptions, and driver-based logic
  • Design, support, and improve integrations and data workflows across Adaptive Planning and Oracle platforms
  • Partner with Finance, RevOps, Data, and IT teams to translate planning requirements into sustainable system solutions
  • Troubleshoot model and integration issues and improve overall system performance, scalability, and usability
  • Create clear documentation and provide knowledge transfer to support long-term ownership and adoption
  • Act as a senior consultant, owning delivery quality and supporting key stakeholder relationships


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of hands-on Workday Adaptive Planning experience
  • Proven experience architecting and building Adaptive Planning solutions, not just maintaining existing models
  • Deep expertise in:
  • Dimensions
  • Sheets
  • Versions
  • Assumptions
  • Driver-based planning logic
  • Complex calculations
  • Performance tuning and model optimization
  • Proven experience integrating Workday Adaptive Planning with Oracle EPM and/or Oracle ERP
  • Strong understanding of planning data structures, financial data flows, and integration best practices
  • Strong knowledge of financial planning and FP&A processes , including budgeting and forecasting
  • Ability to connect technical configuration decisions to business and financial outcomes
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex models to non-technical stakeholders
  • Experience working cross-functionally with Finance, RevOps, Data, and IT

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting SaaS or recurring revenue business models
  • Experience leading or influencing Adaptive Planning best practices and standards
  • Background in multi-entity or high-growth organizations
  • Prior consulting or advisory experience in complex planning environments

Ideal Candidate Profile

  • Senior, hands-on consultant comfortable owning solution delivery end to end
  • Strong technical builder with business-facing communication skills
  • Able to operate independently while partnering across multiple functional teams
  • Skilled at balancing architecture, execution, troubleshooting, and stakeholder management

title: Event Management Engineer (Spyglass)
description:
Observability & Event Management Engineer (Spyglass)

Remote

Contract


Key Responsibilities

  • Spyglass Event Configuration Management Primary Focus
  • Design and implement Event Correlation Rules within Spyglass to aggregate disparate logs and metrics into meaningful business events
  • Configure Event Policies Suppression Rules and Deduplication logic to reduce alert fatigue for L1L2 support teams
  • Build and maintain Spyglass Dashboards that provide real-time visibility into the health of the FMCG application landscape Experience Engineering Mobile and Emerging Tech
  • Integrate Spyglass with diverse data sources Azure Monitor GCP Cloud Logging AWS CloudWatch and ELK Falcon Log Scale
  • Manage the lifecycle of an event from ingestion and normalization to correlation alerting and archival
  • Proactive Monitoring SRE Integration
  • Develop Threshold based and Anomaly detection alerts to identify performance degradation before it impacts the consumer experience
  • Implement Service Level Objective SLO monitoring within Spyglass to track the reliability of critical business paths eg Order-to-Cash Checkout flows
  • Automate the creation of incidents in ITSM tools eg ServiceNow based on Spyglass event triggers
  • Build Situation Rooms or high level executive views within Spyglass for major promotional events or seasonal peaks
  • Hyper scaler Platform Connectivity
  • Ensure seamless event ingestion from Hyperscaler hosted microservices AKSGKE and serverless functions
  • Support the monitoring of Integration Platforms Boomi APIM by capturing and correlating middleware execution events
  • Collaborate with the Cloud Infrastructure team to monitor network latency and connectivity events across the global Azure GCP backbone
  • Senior Developer Specifics
  • Lead the architectural design of the Global Event Management Strategy
  • Define enterprise standards for event metadata severity levels and correlation patterns
  • Mentor junior developers in event driven observability and AIOps principles
  • Conduct Post Mortem analysis of major incidents to refine Spyglass correlation rules and prevent recurrence


Primary Skills Must-Have

  • Spyglass Event Management Expert level proficiency in Spyglass configuration rule writing and dashboarding
  • Event Correlation Deep understanding of event patterns deduplication and suppression logic
  • Observability Integration Hands-on experience connecting Spyglass to Azure Monitor GCP Stackdriver or ELK
  • ITSM Integration Proven experience integrating event platforms with ServiceNow or similar tools
  • Data Normalization Ability to parse and normalize logs events from heterogeneous sources JSON XML Syslog


Secondary Skills Good-to-Have

  • AIOps Familiarity with machine learning based noise reduction and predictive alerting
  • Scripting Proficiency in Python or JavaScript for custom event processing or API integrations
  • Cloud Native Experience monitoring Kubernetes AKSGKE environments
  • FMCG Domain Understanding of critical business hours and high traffic windows for retail sales applications.

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Node.js) | Integração
description:
Descrição da Empresa: A Carefy é uma plataforma especializada em auditoria para operadoras de planos de saúde, utilizando inteligência artificial para combater fraudes e desperdícios no ciclo de atendimento. Combinamos tecnologia avançada e expertise em fluxos de auditoria para gerar economias significativas para nossos clientes. Nosso impacto abrange mais de 8 milhões de pessoas, trabalhando com operadoras líderes como Hapvida e Porto Seguro. Somos movidos pelo compromisso de transformar decisões complexas e melhorar a sustentabilidade do setor de saúde.


Descrição do Cargo: Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Desenvolvedora Backend Sênior com forte visão arquitetural e experiência em sistemas de alta escalabilidade para atuar no time de integração da Carefy. Esse cargo envolve o desenho e desenvolvimento de soluções para garantir a interoperabilidade da plataforma com os sistemas das operadoras de saúde, assegurando fluxo de dados com segurança e alta performance.

Você deverá propor soluções, analisar requisitos técnicos e colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares para entregar projetos de alto impacto. Atuará como referência técnica, participando diretamente da definição de arquiteturas junto aos times de TI dos clientes e traduzindo desafios complexos em soluções estruturadas para o time interno. Também será responsável por elevar o nível técnico da equipe por meio da definição de padrões de engenharia, disseminação de boas práticas e organização das demandas.


Qualificações

  • Acima de 6 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de software
  • Acima de 4 anos com Node.js e TypeScript em produção
  • Acima de 4 anos com bancos relacionais (MySQL), incluindo modelagem e otimização
  • Experiência com arquitetura de software (Clean Architecture, Hexagonal, DDD)
  • Experiência com cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure) e mensageria (RabbitMQ/Kafka)
  • Experiência com APIs RESTful escaláveis
  • Experiência em ambientes de alta criticidade e alto volume de dados
  • Domínio de frameworks como NestJS e/ou Next.js
  • Conhecimento em testes automatizados (TDD, unitários e integração)
  • Habilidade para trabalho colaborativo
  • Visão sistêmica e entendimento do impacto técnico no produto
  • Comunicação assertiva com clientes e time interno
  • Autonomia para conduzir projetos complexos e gerenciar riscos
  • Forte capacidade de resolução de problemas com foco na causa raiz


Será um diferencial:

  • Experiência com PHP: Temos legado e integrações onde esse conhecimento será muito útil para modernização;
  • Experiência na sustentação de aplicações escaláveis utilizando Kubernetes e Terraform;
  • Vivência com pipelines de CI/CD (Bitbucket Pipelines, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, etc.);
  • Conhecimentos em Segurança da Informação (OWASP, OAuth2).


Atribuições:

  • Interface Técnica com Clientes: Atuar como ponto focal em reuniões com os times de TI dos clientes (operadoras de saúde) para alinhar requisitos de integração, layouts de dados e especificações de API;
  • Gestão e Organização Técnica: Traduzir requisitos de negócio em tarefas técnicas claras, quebrando demandas complexas em entregáveis menores para orientar o trabalho dos desenvolvedores Juniors e Plenos;
  • Arquitetura e Design: Projetar e desenvolver soluções escaláveis, resilientes e de alta performance utilizando Node.js (NestJS/Next.js);
  • Sustentação e Confiabilidade: Atuar na manutenção dos sistemas em produção, identificando, diagnosticando e corrigindo bugs e falhas (em sistemas, fontes de dados e APIs) de forma ágil para garantir a continuidade dos serviços;
  • Mentoria e Qualidade: Realizar Code Reviews rigorosos e disseminar boas práticas (Clean Code, SOLID), elevando a barra técnica da equipe;
  • Padronização e Performance: Definir padrões de desenvolvimento e identificar gargalos de performance em cenários de alto volume de dados.


 O que oferecemos?

  • Modalidade Flexível: Híbrido ou 100% Remoto
  • Possibilidade de regime CLT ou PJ;
  • Se CLT, convênio com Bradesco Saúde e Cartão Flash (VR);
  • Ambiente colaborativo e desafiador;
  • Horários flexíveis;
  • Autonomia para propor e implementar novas tecnologias!

title: Médico Nefrologista em Telemedicina (com RQE)
description:
*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO NEFROLOGISTA NA TELADOC HEALTH\"


Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!


A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos e Médicas Especialistas em Nefrologia! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.


*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *

A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.


*O QUE PROCURAMOS: *


Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade de Nefrologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos.


*PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES*


  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Nefrologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.


  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios nefrológicos.


  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anmneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em Nefrologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Habilidade em conduzir entrevistas detalhadas e observar sintomas e sinais da especialidade Nefrologia através de videochamadas.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças nefrológicas.


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde em Nefrologia.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.


  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.


  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.


  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.


  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.


  • Manter-se bem informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.


  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.



REQUISITOS


Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA CONCLUÍDA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO/PÓS EM NEFROLOGIA.


Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Título de Especialista em Nefrologia - RQE (Emitido pelo Conselho do respectivo Estado);
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil);



Experiência:

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Nefrologia, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina.



Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Competência em prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios nefrológicos.



Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.



Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.


Local de Trabalho:

REMOTO


Remuneração e Agendamentos: a combinar durante processo seletivo.



IMPORTANTE:


MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo, bem como possuir CRM do respectivo CNPJ ativo.


Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente em Gastroenterologista.

title: Quality Engineer
description:
Estamos buscando profissionais de Quality Engineering (QE) com foco total em automação.


Você fará parte de um time orientado à inovação, excelência técnica e qualidade ponta a ponta, atuando em um ecossistema distribuído, com integrações, mensageria e pipelines CI/CD maduros.


Responsabilidades


  • Desenvolver, executar e manter testes automatizados com foco em APIs e microserviços .
  • Especificar e implementar cenários em BDD com Gherkin (uso obrigatório) .
  • Registrar, organizar e rastrear cenários, evidências e resultados no Jira/Xray , garantindo rastreabilidade ponta a ponta.
  • Garantir cobertura e eficácia aplicando técnicas de caixa preta e caixa branca .
  • Integrar automações aos pipelines de CI/CD (ex.: Jenkins) .
  • Executar smoke tests e identificar rapidamente falhas críticas.
  • Validar fluxos síncronos e assíncronos, incluindo cenários com mensageria (AWS SQS) .
  • Utilizar Docker para provisionamento de ambientes e execução em pipelines.
  • Apoiar investigação de falhas com ferramentas de observabilidade (logs, métricas, traces) .
  • Colaborar com times de desenvolvimento, produto e operações assegurando qualidade ponta a ponta.


Requisitos Obrigatórios


  • Experiência sólida com Playwright (automação) .
  • Experiência com BDD + Gherkin (uso obrigatório) e Xray com cenários em Gherkin.
  • Domínio profundo de APIs (payloads, autenticação, contratos, timeouts, retries, tratamento de erros).
  • Experiência com CI/CD e execução de testes em pipelines (ex.: Jenkins) .
  • Conhecimento em Docker e ambientes conteinerizados.
  • Experiência em arquitetura distribuída / microserviços.
  • Domínio de técnicas de teste caixa preta e caixa branca .
  • Vivência com smoke testing .
  • Programação em JavaScript (eliminatório) – capacidade real de implementar, manter e evoluir código de automação.


Diferenciais


  • Experiência com validação de fluxos assíncronos e mensageria (SQS/DLQ/reprocessamento) .
  • Noções de Kubernetes/EKS para troubleshooting.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de observabilidade (Dynatrace, OpenTelemetry, Grafana Loki).
  • Experiência com testes de performance e segurança.
  • Conhecimento em cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP) .
  • Noções de Terraform .



A OSF Digital tem orgulho de ser uma empresa que oferece oportunidades iguais, onde você pode ser você mesmo no trabalho. Junte-se a uma comunidade inclusiva e apaixonada de profissionais que ajudam a promover a transformação digital para empresas ao redor do mundo.

Na OSF Digital, acolhemos todas as pessoas e não discriminamos com base em identidade e expressão de gênero, raça, etnia, deficiência, orientação sexual, cor, religião, origem nacional, idade, estado civil ou qualquer outra categoria protegida em qualquer jurisdição onde atuamos.

  • Experiência integrando front-end com APIs REST;
  • Entendimento de princípios modernos de engenharia de software;

  • Vivência em ambientes Ágeis/Scrum.

About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles

title: Software Engineer
description:
Exciting New Career Opportunity: Software Engineer - Quality & AI Infrastructure

Company: Hirebus

Location: Remote in Brazil

Pay: $30K-$60K per year


We're hiring a mid-level engineer to own two things: the quality of our codebase and the early foundations of our AI agent work.


The role

Most of your time will be spent making our existing software more reliable. You'll dig into production bugs, trace them to root cause, and write the tests that should have caught them. You'll review pull requests in a way that raises the bar without demoralizing anyone. You'll tackle the tech debt that everyone complains about in retros but nobody picks up.


The other part — and this is growing — is our AI agent work. We're building tooling, orchestration, and evaluation systems for LLM-powered features. This isn't a research project. It's production software that needs the same rigor as everything else we ship. We need someone who can bring that rigor.


What you'll do

  • Debug and fix issues across the stack, from staging through production
  • Build meaningful test coverage (the kind that actually catches regressions)
  • Review code thoroughly — with context, not just style nits
  • Refactor the parts of the codebase that slow the team down
  • Help define how we ship: observability, release process, quality gates
  • Work with product and design to land features cleanly
  • Contribute to our AI agent infrastructure: tool-calling, orchestration, evaluation, safety


Technical Requirements

  • 7+ years of professional engineering experience with a track record of shipping production SaaS products
  • Expert in Node.js, React, and TypeScript with strong product architecture instincts (scalability, maintainability, speed of iteration)
  • Hands-on Supabase experience: Postgres schema design, RLS policies, edge functions, and auth
  • Shipped production LLM-powered features (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar) with a working understanding of prompt engineering, evals, latency/cost tradeoffs, and guardrails
  • Experience building agentic workflows, RAG systems, or tool-use integrations (MCP, function calling)
  • Excellent written English and self-directed async work style, with meaningful overlap with US Mountain Time
  • Comfortable using AI-native development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) as part of daily workflow


Your first 90 days:

  • Month 1: You've shipped real bug fixes. You're in the PR review rotation and contributing useful feedback. You have context on the parts of the system that break most often.
  • Month 2: Test coverage in your area has improved measurably. You've identified at least one chunk of tech debt worth prioritizing and started on it.
  • Month 3: You've shipped a meaningful refactor. You've made your first contributions to the AI agent infrastructure — something concrete, with results we can point to.


We're not looking for someone who wants to rewrite everything from scratch. We want someone who makes the team steadily better — through reliable fixes, honest reviews, and the kind of infrastructure work that compounds over time. If you're also curious about what engineering looks like as AI agents become part of the workflow, even better.

title: Quality Engineer

  • Conhecimento em Docker e ambientes conteinerizados.
  • Experiência em arquitetura distribuída / microserviços.
  • Domínio de técnicas de teste caixa preta e caixa branca .

  • Noções de Terraform .

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Node.js) | Integração
description:
Descrição da Empresa: A Carefy é uma plataforma especializada em auditoria para operadoras de planos de saúde, utilizando inteligência artificial para combater fraudes e desperdícios no ciclo de atendimento. Combinamos tecnologia avançada e expertise em fluxos de auditoria para gerar economias significativas para nossos clientes. Nosso impacto abrange mais de 8 milhões de pessoas, trabalhando com operadoras líderes como Hapvida e Porto Seguro. Somos movidos pelo compromisso de transformar decisões complexas e melhorar a sustentabilidade do setor de saúde.


Descrição do Cargo: Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Desenvolvedora Backend Sênior com forte visão arquitetural e experiência em sistemas de alta escalabilidade para atuar no time de integração da Carefy. Esse cargo envolve o desenho e desenvolvimento de soluções para garantir a interoperabilidade da plataforma com os sistemas das operadoras de saúde, assegurando fluxo de dados com segurança e alta performance.

Você deverá propor soluções, analisar requisitos técnicos e colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares para entregar projetos de alto impacto. Atuará como referência técnica, participando diretamente da definição de arquiteturas junto aos times de TI dos clientes e traduzindo desafios complexos em soluções estruturadas para o time interno. Também será responsável por elevar o nível técnico da equipe por meio da definição de padrões de engenharia, disseminação de boas práticas e organização das demandas.


Qualificações

  • Acima de 6 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de software
  • Acima de 4 anos com Node.js e TypeScript em produção
  • Acima de 4 anos com bancos relacionais (MySQL), incluindo modelagem e otimização
  • Experiência com arquitetura de software (Clean Architecture, Hexagonal, DDD)
  • Experiência com cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure) e mensageria (RabbitMQ/Kafka)
  • Experiência com APIs RESTful escaláveis
  • Experiência em ambientes de alta criticidade e alto volume de dados
  • Domínio de frameworks como NestJS e/ou Next.js
  • Conhecimento em testes automatizados (TDD, unitários e integração)
  • Habilidade para trabalho colaborativo
  • Visão sistêmica e entendimento do impacto técnico no produto
  • Comunicação assertiva com clientes e time interno
  • Autonomia para conduzir projetos complexos e gerenciar riscos
  • Forte capacidade de resolução de problemas com foco na causa raiz


Será um diferencial:

  • Experiência com PHP: Temos legado e integrações onde esse conhecimento será muito útil para modernização;
  • Experiência na sustentação de aplicações escaláveis utilizando Kubernetes e Terraform;
  • Vivência com pipelines de CI/CD (Bitbucket Pipelines, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, etc.);
  • Conhecimentos em Segurança da Informação (OWASP, OAuth2).


Atribuições:

  • Interface Técnica com Clientes: Atuar como ponto focal em reuniões com os times de TI dos clientes (operadoras de saúde) para alinhar requisitos de integração, layouts de dados e especificações de API;
  • Gestão e Organização Técnica: Traduzir requisitos de negócio em tarefas técnicas claras, quebrando demandas complexas em entregáveis menores para orientar o trabalho dos desenvolvedores Juniors e Plenos;
  • Arquitetura e Design: Projetar e desenvolver soluções escaláveis, resilientes e de alta performance utilizando Node.js (NestJS/Next.js);
  • Sustentação e Confiabilidade: Atuar na manutenção dos sistemas em produção, identificando, diagnosticando e corrigindo bugs e falhas (em sistemas, fontes de dados e APIs) de forma ágil para garantir a continuidade dos serviços;
  • Mentoria e Qualidade: Realizar Code Reviews rigorosos e disseminar boas práticas (Clean Code, SOLID), elevando a barra técnica da equipe;
  • Padronização e Performance: Definir padrões de desenvolvimento e identificar gargalos de performance em cenários de alto volume de dados.


 O que oferecemos?

  • Modalidade Flexível: Híbrido ou 100% Remoto
  • Possibilidade de regime CLT ou PJ;
  • Se CLT, convênio com Bradesco Saúde e Cartão Flash (VR);
  • Ambiente colaborativo e desafiador;
  • Horários flexíveis;
  • Autonomia para propor e implementar novas tecnologias!

description:

title: Senior Backend (Node.js) Engineer
description:
About Us

Founded in 2019 by two best friends, Jon and Eli, XILO set out to revolutionize the insurance industry by solving its biggest challenges. Eli, a brokerage owner, brought invaluable industry expertise, while Jon, an experienced software engineer, saw an opportunity to innovate using technology. Initially launched as a vertical SaaS solution addressing core quoting challenges, XILO has since evolved into a trailblazing Vertical AI company leveraging the latest AI technology to transform the industry. By layering cutting-edge AI solutions onto its SaaS platform, XILO is driving innovation far beyond its original vision. Having recently closed our Series A funding round, XILO is growing rapidly and seeking talented individuals who want to do career-defining work in a mission-driven startup that’s at the forefront of AI innovation.


About The Role

As a Senior Backend Engineer , you’ll be designing and architecting scalable solutions , creating robust APIs, and building new microservices from the ground up —while also improving and optimizing our existing systems. This isn’t just another engineering role. We’re solving real, painful inefficiencies in the insurance space – problems so frustrating that prospects have nearly teared up during sales calls, realizing how much time and effort we could save them. What we’re building isn’t just an upgrade – it’s a fundamental shift in how agencies operate .


What You’ll Do:

  • Architect and develop scalable TypeScript microservices powering XILO’s platform.
  • You’ll have the opportunity to work where your strengths shine and contribute to:
  • AI Agents – Automating complex decision-making and workflows
  • OCR & Document Processing – Extracting, structuring, and analyzing key insights from insurance documents
  • Intelligent Data Mapping – Aggregating and linking all relevant data into a centralized, dynamic user profile
  • Advanced Insurance Operations & CRM – The AI-powered backbone of agencies, seamlessly tracking, managing, and integrating customer data across tools and workflows while replacing outdated, manual processes
  • Forms Builder & Smart Data Entry – A Typeform-like system built for insurance, enabling error-proof, collaborative submissions – fill once, apply everywhere
  • Optimize system performance, reliability, and scalability.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (product, frontend, data science) to deliver seamless integrations.
  • Mentor and guide junior engineers, fostering a collaborative and growth-oriented team culture.
  • Implement best practices for API security, data privacy, and maintainability.


What we’re looking for

  • 7+ years of backend development experience, with a strong foundation in TypeScript and JavaScript.
  • Strong experience with Node.js
  • Proven expertise in designing and developing software product features, with a focus on scalability, performance, and maintainability.
  • Proven expertise in REST API design – including authentication, performance optimization, and security best practices.
  • Experience with XML and SOAP-based integrations, commonly used in the insurance industry.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Nest.js, leveraging its modular architecture for scalable backend services.
  • Familiarity with NX monorepos for structuring and maintaining large-scale applications.
  • Cloud deployment experience on Heroku and AWS, including CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure management.
  • Deep understanding of database management, ORM usage (e.g., TypeORM, Prisma, Sequelize), and zero-downtime migration strategies.
  • Experience designing and implementing microservices architectures, including inter-service communication, data consistency, and service decoupling.
  • Bonus: Full-stack experience with modern frontend frameworks like Angular.
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher).


What we offer

  • Collaborative and innovative work environment
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Budget for English lessons.


Why Join XILO?

  • A great tech startup – Small, fast-moving, and driven by real impact
  • Endless career growth – Help shape the team, tech, and company as we scale
  • Strong leadership & backing – Work alongside experienced founders and tier 1 silicon-valley VCs



Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Graphic Designer


Our Client is hiring a designer to support a high-output marketing team. This is not a brand-from-scratch role. The design system exists, and the job is to execute consistently, extend it intelligently, and keep things moving without hand-holding.


You’ll work directly with Marketing, with guidance from the Creative Director. Most of what you produce will show up in demand gen campaigns, event programs, and product marketing. It needs to look sharp, ship fast, and hold up across channels.


What you’ll do

  • You’ll be responsible for a wide range of design work tied directly to pipeline-driving campaigns
  • Create graphics for social, paid campaigns, email, and web
  • Design and iterate on landing pages in Webflow
  • Produce visual assets for webinars, virtual events, and campaigns
  • Design print collateral and occasional physical assets (including SWAG)
  • Create GIFs, motion elements, and lightweight animations
  • Edit video for social distribution and website use
  • Support ongoing campaign launches with fast-turn creative
  • This is a volume role, and you’ll be expected to make good decisions quickly and maintain quality under pace.


What matters in this role

  • You can operate inside an existing brand system without needing constant direction
  • You understand how design actually shows up in B2B marketing, not just how it looks in a portfolio
  • You’re comfortable moving between formats. Static, motion, web, video. No one is handing off perfect briefs every time
  • You have strong judgment about what’s “good enough to ship” vs what needs refinement
  • You can manage your own workflow and keep projects moving without bottlenecks


Requirements

  • 4+ years in a design role, ideally supporting marketing or growth teams
  • Strong portfolio that shows real campaign work, not just one-off visuals
  • Experience designing in Webflow (not just Figma concepts)
  • Experience with motion design and basic animation (GIFs, short-form video)
  • Video editing experience for social and web content
  • Fluency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite


Context for the work

Our client sells to B2B marketing teams running webinars and virtual events as part of pipeline generation. That means the creative you produce will be tied directly to:

  • Driving registrations and product demos
  • Increasing engagement
  • Supporting sales follow-up
  • Reinforcing brand credibility with senior marketing leaders

The output needs to feel polished, but it has to perform, not just look good.


What this is not

  • Not a pure brand exploration role
  • Not a pixel-perfect, weeks-per-project environment
  • Not isolated design work handed over a wall


You’ll be in the middle of campaigns, working closely with marketers who are moving fast and expect the same from you.


If that sounds like your kind of environment, this will be a good fit.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Flutter/Node.js)

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Graphic Designer


Our Client is hiring a designer to support a high-output marketing team. This is not a brand-from-scratch role. The design system exists, and the job is to execute consistently, extend it intelligently, and keep things moving without hand-holding.


You’ll work directly with Marketing, with guidance from the Creative Director. Most of what you produce will show up in demand gen campaigns, event programs, and product marketing. It needs to look sharp, ship fast, and hold up across channels.


What you’ll do

  • You’ll be responsible for a wide range of design work tied directly to pipeline-driving campaigns
  • Create graphics for social, paid campaigns, email, and web
  • Design and iterate on landing pages in Webflow
  • Produce visual assets for webinars, virtual events, and campaigns
  • Design print collateral and occasional physical assets (including SWAG)
  • Create GIFs, motion elements, and lightweight animations
  • Edit video for social distribution and website use
  • Support ongoing campaign launches with fast-turn creative
  • This is a volume role, and you’ll be expected to make good decisions quickly and maintain quality under pace.


What matters in this role

  • You can operate inside an existing brand system without needing constant direction
  • You understand how design actually shows up in B2B marketing, not just how it looks in a portfolio
  • You’re comfortable moving between formats. Static, motion, web, video. No one is handing off perfect briefs every time
  • You have strong judgment about what’s “good enough to ship” vs what needs refinement
  • You can manage your own workflow and keep projects moving without bottlenecks


Requirements

  • 4+ years in a design role, ideally supporting marketing or growth teams
  • Strong portfolio that shows real campaign work, not just one-off visuals
  • Experience designing in Webflow (not just Figma concepts)
  • Experience with motion design and basic animation (GIFs, short-form video)
  • Video editing experience for social and web content
  • Fluency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite


Context for the work

Our client sells to B2B marketing teams running webinars and virtual events as part of pipeline generation. That means the creative you produce will be tied directly to:

  • Driving registrations and product demos
  • Increasing engagement
  • Supporting sales follow-up
  • Reinforcing brand credibility with senior marketing leaders

The output needs to feel polished, but it has to perform, not just look good.


What this is not

  • Not a pure brand exploration role
  • Not a pixel-perfect, weeks-per-project environment
  • Not isolated design work handed over a wall


You’ll be in the middle of campaigns, working closely with marketers who are moving fast and expect the same from you.


If that sounds like your kind of environment, this will be a good fit.

title: Senior QA Engineer
description:
We Are Sportingtech :


Sportingtech is a multi-award-winning provider of turnkey betting and gaming solutions designed for regulated and emerging markets around the world. With offices in Malta, Bulgaria, London, Brazil and Portugal, our iGaming platform offers everything covering sportsbook and casino via a modular system and intuitive back office for a fully omni-channel solution. Our unparalleled ability to cater for local-market customisation and operator preferences provides players with an optimal betting experience, resulting in proven growth for our rapidly expanding customer base.


Where you Fit In:


As a Senior QA Engineer , you are a key technical leader within Quality Engineering. You own quality across complex, mission-critical systems and play an active role in shaping automation standards, testing strategy, and long-term reliability.


You go beyond execution — influencing decisions and ensuring quality is embedded into the engineering lifecycle.


You are a highly technical, systems-oriented QA professional with strong automation expertise.

You understand how systems interact across the stack and think proactively about risk, scalability, and long-term maintainability. You don’t just validate features — you anticipate failure points, analyze trade-offs, and design quality solutions accordingly.

You are confident leading discussions, mentoring others, and raising the bar for engineering excellence.


The impact you will have:


  • Troubleshoot critical issues across environments and support root cause analysis
  • Reduce flakiness and improve test stability and execution reliability
  • Contribute to roadmap discussions and long-term quality vision
  • Identify strategic quality risks and advocate for prioritization
  • Mentor other QA engineers and strengthen onboarding and technical standards
  • Continuously improving the Automation Framework and overall automation coverage
  • Lead testing strategy for complex, cross-team systems.


What we’re looking for:


Technical

  • Strong experience in automation testing
  • Advanced English
  • Understanding of system architecture and cross-team dependencies
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex issues across the full stack
  • Experience improving automation reliability and non-functional coverage
  • Strategic thinking around scalability and long-term maintainability.


Execution

  • Proven ability to lead complex, multi-team initiatives
  • Breaks down large challenges into structured execution plans
  • Owns quality from design through production
  • Aligns technical decisions with broader company goals.


Collaboration & Influence

  • Clearly communicates risks, trade-offs, and system impact
  • Act as a mentor to teammates and contributes to team growth
  • Builds consensus and leads by example.


This role is Remote based in Brazil.



Sportingtech is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and are committed to providing a work environment of mutual respect to everyone without regard to race, colour, religion, national origin, age, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances. Please read this policy carefully to understand how we handle your personal data.

title: Senior Backend (Node.js) Engineer
description:
About Us

Founded in 2019 by two best friends, Jon and Eli, XILO set out to revolutionize the insurance industry by solving its biggest challenges. Eli, a brokerage owner, brought invaluable industry expertise, while Jon, an experienced software engineer, saw an opportunity to innovate using technology. Initially launched as a vertical SaaS solution addressing core quoting challenges, XILO has since evolved into a trailblazing Vertical AI company leveraging the latest AI technology to transform the industry. By layering cutting-edge AI solutions onto its SaaS platform, XILO is driving innovation far beyond its original vision. Having recently closed our Series A funding round, XILO is growing rapidly and seeking talented individuals who want to do career-defining work in a mission-driven startup that’s at the forefront of AI innovation.


About The Role

As a Senior Backend Engineer , you’ll be designing and architecting scalable solutions , creating robust APIs, and building new microservices from the ground up —while also improving and optimizing our existing systems. This isn’t just another engineering role. We’re solving real, painful inefficiencies in the insurance space – problems so frustrating that prospects have nearly teared up during sales calls, realizing how much time and effort we could save them. What we’re building isn’t just an upgrade – it’s a fundamental shift in how agencies operate .


What You’ll Do:

  • Architect and develop scalable TypeScript microservices powering XILO’s platform.
  • You’ll have the opportunity to work where your strengths shine and contribute to:
  • AI Agents – Automating complex decision-making and workflows
  • OCR & Document Processing – Extracting, structuring, and analyzing key insights from insurance documents
  • Intelligent Data Mapping – Aggregating and linking all relevant data into a centralized, dynamic user profile
  • Advanced Insurance Operations & CRM – The AI-powered backbone of agencies, seamlessly tracking, managing, and integrating customer data across tools and workflows while replacing outdated, manual processes
  • Forms Builder & Smart Data Entry – A Typeform-like system built for insurance, enabling error-proof, collaborative submissions – fill once, apply everywhere
  • Optimize system performance, reliability, and scalability.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (product, frontend, data science) to deliver seamless integrations.
  • Mentor and guide junior engineers, fostering a collaborative and growth-oriented team culture.
  • Implement best practices for API security, data privacy, and maintainability.


What we’re looking for

  • 7+ years of backend development experience, with a strong foundation in TypeScript and JavaScript.
  • Strong experience with Node.js
  • Proven expertise in designing and developing software product features, with a focus on scalability, performance, and maintainability.
  • Proven expertise in REST API design – including authentication, performance optimization, and security best practices.
  • Experience with XML and SOAP-based integrations, commonly used in the insurance industry.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Nest.js, leveraging its modular architecture for scalable backend services.
  • Familiarity with NX monorepos for structuring and maintaining large-scale applications.
  • Cloud deployment experience on Heroku and AWS, including CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure management.
  • Deep understanding of database management, ORM usage (e.g., TypeORM, Prisma, Sequelize), and zero-downtime migration strategies.
  • Experience designing and implementing microservices architectures, including inter-service communication, data consistency, and service decoupling.
  • Bonus: Full-stack experience with modern frontend frameworks like Angular.
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher).


What we offer

  • Collaborative and innovative work environment
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Budget for English lessons.


Why Join XILO?

  • A great tech startup – Small, fast-moving, and driven by real impact
  • Endless career growth – Help shape the team, tech, and company as we scale
  • Strong leadership & backing – Work alongside experienced founders and tier 1 silicon-valley VCs



Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
About Us

Marketing Ninjas is a cutting-edge marketing agency specializing in helping restoration companies gain more referral partners and secure exclusive leads. As a faith-driven and ninja-themed company, we operate with the highest standards, integrity, and a commitment to excellence. Our mission is to empower our clients with the tools and strategies they need to grow their businesses successfully.


Job Overview

We’re looking for a Client Success Manager (CSM) who is passionate about building relationships, ensuring client satisfaction, and driving results. The CSM will serve as the primary point of contact for our clients, ensuring they see maximum value from our services and continue to grow with us. This role requires exceptional communication skills, a strong command of English with minimal accent , and a proactive approach to client engagement.


Key Responsibilities

  • Client Onboarding & Relationship Management: Guide new clients through the onboarding process, ensuring a smooth and positive experience.
  • Ongoing Support & Strategy: Regularly check in with clients to review performance, provide strategic insights, and optimize their marketing campaigns.
  • Retention & Growth: Identify opportunities for upselling or cross-selling additional services to help clients scale their businesses.
  • Issue Resolution: Address client concerns promptly and professionally, working with internal teams to resolve any challenges.
  • Training & Education: Educate clients on best practices for using our Marketing Ninjas Lead Engine , powered by GoHighLevel .
  • Performance Monitoring: Track client success metrics and proactively reach out to offer guidance and improvements.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with our sales, marketing, and fulfillment teams using Slack, ClickUp, and GoHighLevel to ensure a seamless client experience.


What We’re Looking For

  • Experience: 2+ years in a client success, account management, or customer service role (preferably in digital marketing, SaaS, or home services industries).
  • Communication Skills:Fluent English speaker with excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Minimal accent for clear and effective communication with U.S.-based clients.
  • Tech-Savvy: Experience using GoHighLevel, Slack, and ClickUp (or similar CRM and project management tools).
  • Comfortable with marketing automation and CRM tools.
  • Problem-Solving: Ability to think critically and proactively address client concerns.
  • Results-Driven: Passionate about helping clients succeed and achieving high retention rates.
  • Organized & Detail-Oriented: Ability to manage multiple clients and tasks efficiently.
  • Faith & Integrity: A commitment to conducting business with the highest ethical standards.


Why Join Marketing Ninjas?

  • Work with a mission-driven team that operates with integrity and excellence.
  • Remote work flexibility – work from anywhere!
  • Opportunities for growth in a fast-paced, ninja-themed marketing agency.
  • Competitive salary + performance-based incentives.
  • Supportive team environment with a strong focus on faith, values, and client success.


Ready to Join the Ninja Squad?

If you’re passionate about helping businesses grow , building strong client relationships , and delivering exceptional service , we’d love to hear from you! Apply today and become part of the Marketing Ninjas team.

title: CAD Software Specialist (FreeCAD/OpenSCAD /LibreCAD) - 64851
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview: We are seeking a CAD Software Specialist to create and document technical models and drawings using open-source CAD tools. The role requires strong attention to detail, structured documentation of modeling workflows, and the ability to produce export-ready technical files.


Requirements

  • Strong English communication skills (written and spoken).
  • Computer with 16 GB RAM or more (mandatory).

  • Submit native project files and structured documentation explaining design intent, constraints, and workflow.


Benefits:

  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.

  • Duration of contract: 16 weeks

title: Data Scientist - Sênior (Motor de Busca)
description:
No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro, maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina, e a Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no país.


Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.


E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?


Buscamos uma pessoa Cientista de Dados para atuar na squad de Busca, com foco em Busca Semântica, relevância e ranking. Essa posição tem papel estratégico na evolução da experiência de busca, atuando desde a definição de hipóteses até a implementação, experimentação e mensuração de impacto, com forte interface com Produto, Engenharia e Negócio.


Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e evoluir soluções de Busca Semântica utilizando Elasticsearch, indo além da busca lexical tradicional.
  • Atuar na definição e otimização de: Estrutura de índices e mappings Estratégias de ranking híbrido (lexical + semântico) Queries semânticas (ex: embeddings, similarity search, boosting contextual)
  • Trabalhar com vetorização de conteúdo (produtos, termos de busca, atributos) para melhoria de relevância.
  • Avaliar e evoluir métricas de qualidade de busca. Conduzir testes A/B e experimentos controlados para validar impacto das melhorias semânticas. Traduzir problemas de negócio e experiência do usuário em soluções analíticas e modelos de dados.
  • Atuar em parceria com Engenharia e Produto na definição do roadmap técnico de busca. Garantir boas práticas de ciência de dados: versionamento, documentação, reprodutibilidade e monitoramento.
  • Apoiar tecnicamente outros cientistas de dados do time, elevando o nível das discussões técnicas.


Requisitos necessários

  • Formação superior completa em Ciência da Computação, Estatística, Matemática ou áreas afins. Experiência comprovada de 5 a 7 anos em projetos de ciência de dados.
  • Experiência prática com Busca Semântica em Elasticsearch
  • Experiência com Information Retrieval (IR) e conceitos de relevância.
  • Conhecimento em NLP aplicado à busca (ex: embeddings, similaridade textual).
  • Experiência com modelos de ranking ou learning to rank.
  • Domínio de SQL para análise de grandes volumes de dados.
  • Proficiência em Python para análise de dados, experimentação e modelagem.
  • Vivência com experimentação e testes A/B em ambientes de produto.
  • Capacidade de comunicação clara com públicos técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Experiência em produtos digitais com alto volume de dados. Noções de MLOps.
  • Sólida vivência em versionamento de código (Git), com prática de code review, padrões de branches e integração contínua.


Diferenciais

  • Vivência com BigQuery ou data lakes.
  • Experiência prévia em e-commerce, marketplace ou plataformas de discovery.
  • Experiência em observabilidade e monitoramento da qualidade da busca.
  • Conhecimento em técnicas de visualização de dados e storytelling.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de business intelligence, como Power BI.


Perfil esperado

  • Forte mentalidade de produto e experiência do usuário.

title: Quality Engineer
description:

title: Account Manager
description:
Hey, Dingus!


Yep, you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we're on the hunt for a sharp, people-first Account Manager who can build lasting client relationships, keep projects moving, and make sure every client feels informed, supported, and confident every step of the way.


About Us


Dingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an \"unlimited get-shit-done\" subscription for our clients, from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.

Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.


What You'll Do


  • Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, managing relationships, setting expectations, and delivering excellent service at every touchpoint.
  • Translate client marketing goals into clear, actionable tasks, and coordinate with the Marketing Coordinator for execution.
  • Lead regular client meetings, share updates and deliverables, and ensure everything stays aligned with client expectations.
  • Use Jiminny to document meetings, capture key takeaways, and package notes, action items, and recordings using our meeting template.
  • Review final deliverables before submission to ensure quality, relevance, and client readiness.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with clients and industry contacts to strengthen collaboration and drive long-term success.
  • Handle client concerns and dynamics with professionalism, composure, and emotional intelligence.


What You Bring


  • 2+ years of experience in account management, client services, or a similar client-facing role.
  • Clear, confident communication skills, you can manage expectations, present deliverables, and handle tough conversations without breaking a sweat.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to balance multiple clients, meetings, and deadlines simultaneously.
  • A strategic mindset, you connect client goals to the bigger picture and collaborate with senior team members to get there.
  • High emotional intelligence, you read the room, stay composed under pressure, and build trust naturally.
  • Proficiency using AI tools such as Claude and Gemini to improve workflows, streamline communication, and enhance overall efficiency.
  • Copywriting experience, you can craft clear, on-brand messaging and support content needs when required.
  • Experience in a digital agency or marketing environment is a strong plus.
  • Ability to work independently in a fully remote, fast-paced environment.


Bonus Points

  • Familiarity with project management or CRM tools.
  • Experience presenting creative or marketing work to clients.
  • Background in digital marketing, understanding what your team is building makes you a better advocate for your clients.


Work Details

  • Hours: 9 A.M. – 5 P.M. MST, Monday to Friday
  • Reports to the Director of Accounts
  • Requires a working level of written and spoken English


If you're someone who genuinely loves building relationships, thrives on keeping things organized and on track, and takes pride in making clients feel like they're in the best hands, we want to hear from you.


Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

title: Junior Data Analyst - Remote, Brazil (New Graduates Welcome) Wowoo · Full-time · 100% Remote
description:
About Wowoo Wowoo is a global consumer technology company building AI-powered mobile applications used by millions of people around the world. Our portfolio includes ChatPrime, AI Baby Generator, and FaceForm. As part of our expansion in Latin America, we're opening entry-level positions for talented new graduates and early-career professionals in Brazil.

We pay in USD, work fully remote, and invest heavily in the growth of our junior team members.

The Role We're hiring a Junior Data Analyst to join our growth and product analytics team. This is an entry-level role designed for recent graduates or early-career analysts who want to learn from a senior global team and work on real, high-impact business problems from day one.

You'll help us understand how millions of users discover, subscribe to, and engage with our products, and your analysis will directly influence product and marketing decisions.

What You'll Do

  • Build dashboards and reports in BigQuery, Looker, and Metabase to track product, marketing, and revenue metrics
  • Analyze user behavior, subscription funnels, and marketing campaign performance
  • Partner with product managers, marketers, and engineers to answer business questions with data
  • Document findings clearly and present insights to a global team
  • Learn modern data stack tools and grow into a senior analyst over time

What We're Looking For

  • Bachelor's degree (completed or in final year) in a quantitative or analytical field: Statistics, Economics, Engineering, Computer Science, Business Analytics, Mathematics, or similar
  • Solid SQL fundamentals (we'll test this) or strong willingness to master SQL within the first weeks
  • Comfort with spreadsheets and basic data manipulation
  • Strong written English; comfortable communicating findings clearly in writing
  • Curious, analytical mindset and attention to detail
  • Self-motivated and comfortable working independently in a remote environment

Nice to Have

  • Internship experience in data, analytics, business intelligence, or consulting
  • Familiarity with Python, R, BigQuery, Looker, Tableau, or Metabase
  • Coursework or projects in statistics, A/B testing, or experimentation
  • Interest in consumer apps, subscription business models, or growth marketing

What We Offer

  • Competitive USD compensation, well above local market for entry-level roles
  • 100% remote, work from anywhere in Brazil
  • Direct mentorship from senior analysts and founders
  • Real ownership and visibility from day one - no coffee runs, no busywork
  • Flexible hours and async-first culture
  • Clear growth path to Mid-level Analyst within 18-24 months
  • Learning budget for courses, books, and conferences

Who Should Apply If you just graduated or are graduating soon, this is for you. If you've been doing internships and want your first full-time role at an international company, this is for you. If you're switching careers from a non-technical background but have strong analytical skills and SQL chops, we want to hear from you.

We don't care which university you attended. We care about how you think.

  • Wowoo is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds.
