title: Product Owner Sênior
description:
Estamos em busca de um Product Owner Sênior para liderar a evolução de produtos digitais no segmento de saúde, com forte proximidade das rotinas médicas, jornadas de consulta, fluxos clínicos e necessidades reais dos médicos e times assistenciais.

Esse profissional será responsável por atuar como elo entre negócio, tecnologia, usuários e stakeholders, garantindo que as decisões de produto gerem valor para a operação, melhorem a experiência dos profissionais de saúde e pacientes, e sustentem os objetivos estratégicos da organização.


O perfil ideal combina sólida experiência em produto com capacidade de entender a dinâmica do ambiente de saúde, especialmente a lógica por trás de consultas médicas, documentação clínica, jornadas assistenciais, gargalos operacionais e usabilidade para o médico no dia a dia.

Principais responsabilidades


  • Gerenciar e priorizar o backlog do produto, garantindo alinhamento com os objetivos do negócio e as necessidades dos usuários.
  • Traduzir objetivos estratégicos em requisitos claros, épicos, histórias de usuário e critérios de aceitação.
  • Atuar em parceria com stakeholders das áreas de saúde, operação, negócio, tecnologia, UX e dados.
  • Entender e mapear fluxos ponta a ponta do ambiente de saúde, incluindo consultas, agendamentos, prontuários, documentação clínica e rotinas de apoio ao médico.
  • Levantar necessidades diretamente com usuários, especialmente médicos, equipes clínicas e times operacionais.
  • Identificar dores nas rotinas médicas e administrativas, transformando essas necessidades em oportunidades de produto.
  • Priorizar funcionalidades com base em valor de negócio, impacto para o usuário, viabilidade técnica e urgência.
  • Participar ativamente das cerimônias ágeis, apoiando o time com direcionamento funcional e esclarecimento contínuo de requisitos.
  • Garantir que o produto entregue eficiência operacional, boa usabilidade, adoção e resultados mensuráveis.
  • Conduzir ou apoiar atividades de discovery, como entrevistas, análise de fluxos, validações e testes de hipótese.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com times de engenharia e design para construir soluções práticas e centradas no usuário.
  • Acompanhar indicadores de desempenho do produto, métricas de uso, feedbacks e resultados operacionais.
  • Promover a melhoria contínua dos produtos, equilibrando necessidades regulatórias, operacionais e de experiência do usuário.
  • Atuar como principal referência da squad em decisões de escopo, priorização e direcionamento funcional.


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência comprovada como Product Owner, Product Owner Sênior ou função equivalente em produto.
  • Vivência sólida em ambientes ágeis, com atuação junto a squads multidisciplinares.
  • Experiência no segmento de saúde, healthtech, operações clínicas, sistemas médicos ou contextos correlatos.
  • Forte compreensão de fluxos de saúde, especialmente relacionados a consultas médicas, rotina do médico, agendamentos, jornada do paciente e necessidades assistenciais.
  • Capacidade de compreender o que o médico precisa em termos de sistema, processo e usabilidade, mesmo quando a demanda não vem totalmente estruturada.
  • Experiência na escrita de histórias de usuário, definição de critérios de aceitação e gestão estruturada de backlog.
  • Habilidade de relacionamento e gestão de stakeholders.
  • Capacidade de conectar estratégia de negócio com execução de produto e entrega de tecnologia.
  • Perfil analítico, com capacidade de usar dados, evidências e feedbacks para apoiar priorização e tomada de decisão.
  • Capacidade de atuar em ambientes complexos, com múltiplos stakeholders e mudanças de prioridade.


Requisitos desejáveis

  • Experiência prévia com produtos relacionados a: prontuário eletrônico,
  • agendamento de consultas, telemedicina, otimização de fluxo clínico, portais médicos, jornada do paciente, coordenação do cuidado, plataformas assistenciais.
  • Familiaridade com requisitos regulatórios, privacidade e compliance no setor de saúde.
  • Experiência com integrações entre sistemas de saúde e interoperabilidade.
  • Vivência com médicos, clínicas, hospitais, centros diagnósticos ou operações assistenciais.
  • Experiência com discovery e desenho de serviços em contexto de saúde.
  • Conhecimento de métricas relacionadas à eficiência clínica, fluxo de atendimento, adoção e performance operacional.


Competências esperadas

  • Forte senso de dono sobre o produto
  • Excelente capacidade de priorização
  • Visão de negócio com foco no usuário
  • Capacidade de lidar com ambiguidade e transformar demandas em backlog acionável
  • Escuta ativa e boa facilitação
  • Empatia com médicos, pacientes e equipes operacionais
  • Comunicação clara com públicos técnicos e não técnicos
  • Pensamento estruturado para solução de problemas
  • Tomada de decisão orientada a valor e impacto
  • Alto nível de autonomia e accountability


O que esperamos de sucesso nessa posição


  • O roadmap do produto reflita prioridades reais do negócio e da operação em saúde.
  • Médicos e usuários clínicos percebam que o produto apoia, e não dificulta, a rotina do dia a dia.
  • Os requisitos estejam claros o suficiente para permitir execução eficiente pelo time de tecnologia.
  • As entregas gerem ganhos concretos de eficiência, qualidade operacional, adoção e experiência do usuário.
  • A squad tenha clareza sobre prioridades, contexto e objetivos de negócio.


Diferencial importante

Buscamos alguém que não apenas conheça produto, mas que tenha sensibilidade para entender a lógica do ambiente médico, conseguindo traduzir necessidades assistenciais e operacionais em soluções digitais de alto valor.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Conduzir cerimônias ágeis (dailies, sprints, retrospectivas) e adaptar frameworks (Scrum, Kanban, híbrido) conforme o contexto.

  • Antecipar riscos, dependências e gargalos, propondo planos de mitigação.
  • Gerenciar fornecedores e parceiros envolvidos nas entregas.
  • Garantir documentação estruturada de processos, decisões e aprendizados.
  • Impulsionar melhoria contínua nas práticas de gestão de projetos da área de dados.


Requisitos

  • Experiência consolidada (5+ anos) em gestão de projetos de tecnologia, sendo ao menos 2 anos em projetos de dados ou analytics.
  • Conhecimento prático do ecossistema de dados: data warehouse, data lake, ETL/ELT, modelagem de dados e ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Qlik, Tableau ou similares).
  • Domínio de metodologias ágeis e tradicionais (Scrum, Kanban, PMBOK/Waterfall), com flexibilidade de aplicação.

title: Gerente de segurança da informação
description:
O Grupo Fleury é uma das maiores e mais respeitadas instituições de medicina e saúde do Brasil. Referência por sua excelência técnica, médica e de atendimento, é também destaque nas melhores práticas ESG.


Além dos serviços de medicina diagnóstica, o Grupo Fleury conta com uma oferta crescente de serviços que buscam responder às necessidades das pessoas, além de gerar sustentabilidade para o sistema de saúde com a melhor utilização dos recursos investidos. Essas soluções refletem o posicionamento estratégico da empresa de ser um ecossistema de saúde integrada, preventiva e híbrida, combinando ofertas físicas e digitais.


Acreditamos que carreira e propósito caminham juntos, e costumamos falar que somos apaixonados pelas pessoas e pelo que fazemos. Isso reflete em nosso dia a dia, por meio de um trabalho que impacta vidas. Faz parte da nossa essência cuidar das pessoas, colocando as colaboradoras, colaboradores, médicas, médicos e clientes sempre no centro.


Se você tem atitude positiva, empatia, adaptabilidade e deseja se desenvolver em um ambiente repleto de profissionais referências no mercado que prezam por respeito, excelência e inovação, abrace a oportunidade de levar saúde e bem-estar para a plena realização das pessoas!

Venha transformar sua paixão em carreira!


Quais são os desafios da área e do cargo:


Esta pessoa terá como objetivo atuar de forma alinhada à visão estratégica de Negócios do Grupo Fleury, contribuindo para a construção de um ecossistema de Saúde integrado, preventivo e híbrido, tendo como principal foco o cuidado com as pessoas.


Garantir a proteção e a disponibilidade das informações corporativas por meio de políticas robustas de segurança, mitigando riscos e assegurando a continuidade do negócio. Atuar de forma estratégica em projetos, integrando a segurança desde a concepção e fortalecendo a cultura organizacional.


Promover a conscientização dos colaboradores, acompanhar tendências e aplicar soluções inovadoras para manter a conformidade e a resiliência digital. Além disso, liderar a gestão eficiente de recursos, negociar com parceiros e desenvolver uma equipe de alta performance, orientada a resultados e inovação contínua.


Se você tem interesse em fazer parte desse propósito e deseja estar sempre um passo a frente do mercado, vem com a gente!


Principais atividades:


  • Liderança estratégica: Coordenação da área de Segurança da Informação, garantindo proteção, continuidade e integridade dos serviços de TI em toda a organização.
  • Gestão de ambiente complexo: Proteção de milhares de usuários, ativos, sistemas, sites e operações críticas 24x7, incluindo unidades e parceiros.
  • Segurança de parceiros: Garantia de acessos seguros e operação contínua para laboratórios e stakeholders externos.
  • Planejamento estratégico: Definição e implementação da estratégia de segurança da informação, alinhada ao negócio e às melhores práticas de mercado (ISO 27001, NIST, CIS).
  • Governança e compliance: Estruturação de políticas, processos e comitês executivos, assegurando conformidade, auditorias e evolução da maturidade em segurança.
  • Gestão de identidade e acessos: Controle de acessos, credenciais, MFA, PAM e gestão de riscos em sistemas e infraestrutura.
  • Gestão de incidentes: Monitoramento contínuo e resposta eficaz a incidentes de segurança, minimizando impactos operacionais.
  • Gestão de vulnerabilidades: Redução de riscos por meio de atualização de patches, correção de falhas e fortalecimento da infraestrutura.
  • Proteção de infraestrutura crítica: Administração de firewalls, acessos privilegiados e segurança perimetral.
  • Gestão financeira: Planejamento e controle orçamentário (OPEX/CAPEX), negociação com fornecedores e otimização de investimentos.
  • Cultura de segurança: Condução de treinamentos, campanhas de conscientização e simulações para engajamento dos colaboradores.
  • Inovação e resiliência: Implementação de soluções modernas para antecipar ameaças e garantir conformidade regulatória.
  • Impacto no negócio: Atuação estratégica para sustentar operações seguras e contribuir com a missão organizacional.


Buscamos alguém que apresente:


  • Formação: Superior em áreas relacionadas à Engenharia, Tecnologia da Informação, Segurança da Informação ou áreas afins
  • Certificações como CISSP, CISM, ISO 27001
  • Conhecimento em Gestão de Privacidade e Riscos
  • Conformidade regulatória (LGPD, GDPR)


Conhecimento específicos:


  • Políticas de segurança
  • Soluções de arquivamento de dados para segurança e auditoria, análise forense, prática de engenharia social.
  • Gestão direta de Red Team, Blue Team e Gestão de Acessos
  • Campanhas de sensibilização e conscientização de segurança da informação na organização
  • Soluções de segurança da informação tais como IPS, IDS, Firewall, criptografia, SIEM, ZTNA, MDM, ACS, Proxy, Anti-APT, WAF e demais soluções de segurança


Antes da inscrição na vaga, é importante verificar se você atende aos requisitos e se conecta com nosso propósito.


Informações da vaga:


Modelo de Trabalho: Aberto a negociação ( Atuação poderá ser home, ou Hibrido)

Carga Horária: 220h

Escala: Segunda á sexta

Horário de Trabalho: 08h00 ás 17h48


Antes da inscrição na vaga, é importante verificar se você atende aos requisitos e se conecta com nosso propósito.


Nossa essência inspira o dia a dia, por isso, buscamos pessoas apaixonadas pelo que fazem, e que:


• Estimulem um ambiente de troca de conhecimentos, compartilhando experiências, possibilitando a interdependência entre os times;

• Estejam em constante movimento, investindo em autodesenvolvimento e atuando como facilitadora no desenvolvimento das outras pessoas;

• Busquem consciência social de diversidade e inclusão, cooperando com a construção de um ambiente colaborativo;

• Identifiquem e antecipem as necessidades dos clientes, agindo prontamente para encontrar soluções adequadas e personalizadas;

• Planejem e executem o trabalho com excelência a fim de atingir os resultados esperados, com a visão de inovação e agilidade;

• Gerem e implementem novas ideias, buscando constantemente por melhorias para a experimentação de novas abordagens e a adaptação às mudanças do mercado.


Cuidamos de você em cada etapa da sua jornada!


Saúde e Bem-estar:

• Assistência médica e odontológica para você e sua família;

• Ambulatório com clínica médica ou atendimento por telemedicina;

• Linhas de cuidado especializadas: gestantes, adoção, obesidade, oncologia, entre outras;

• Acesso à plataforma OrienteMe para sessões de terapia e orientação nutricional;

• Licença maternidade e paternidade estendidas;

• Acesso ao Wellhub para práticas esportivas e qualidade de vida.


Proteção e estabilidade:

• Previdência privada;

• Participação nos lucros;

• Seguro de vida.


Facilidades para o dia a dia:

• Vale-Alimentação;

• Vale-Refeição;

• Vale-Transporte;

• Auxílio-Creche;

• Clube de Descontos com lojas, farmácias, viagem, beleza, cultura, lazer, entre outros serviços.


Desenvolvimento e educação:

• Plataforma de ensino;

• Parcerias educacionais com descontos em cursos e instituições.


Aqui, o cuidado vai além dos benefícios — ele está presente em cada momento da sua trajetória.


Promovemos uma cultura inclusiva, focada na equidade e na valorização das diferenças. Nossas vagas são abertas para todos os públicos e, simbolizando a nossa intencionalidade, oferecemos oportunidades afirmativas.


Nosso compromisso vai além do cumprimento das legislações que incentivam a diversidade e inclusão. Trabalhamos ativamente para ampliar a representatividade de nossas pessoas, pensando em raça, etnia, gênero, gerações, pessoas com deficiência e LGBTQIAPN+ em nosso time, além de fortalecer a representatividade de mulheres negras, indígenas, chefes de família.


Para conhecer mais sobre o Grupo Fleury, acesse o site:


O Grupo Fleury informa que a participação em seus processos seletivos é gratuita e nenhuma empresa terceira está autorizada a cobrar valores para a candidatura às vagas, ao treinamento, ao material didático ou qualquer outra despesa relacionada.

title: Quality Assurance Analyst
description:
Company Description

Metrobi is a delivery fulfillment platform designed specifically to support local businesses. We help these businesses manage their deliveries efficiently by connecting them with skilled drivers tailored to meet their delivery needs. Additionally, we provide essential tools for logistical, financial, and marketing support, empowering local food and beverage makers to expand their businesses


Role of the QA Team:

Our QA team is crucial in ensuring the quality of our platform. There are two main tasks you will focus on:

  • Bug Analysis: Understand and diagnose bugs that make it into production. This requires a solid understanding of our product and excellent problem-solving skills.
  • Proactively finding issues that affect users: Identify parts of the system that need to be improved according to feedback coming from users and testing. You need to be able to clearly report the problem and propose a solution.
  • Feature Verification: Manually check whether new features work as intended. This involves strong analytical skills to assess user experience and interface design.


While specific technical skills like SQL, Git, reading Python code, and creating automated tests are very beneficial, they are not required.


We're looking for candidates with strong English, product usage analysis skills, and excellent communication. This is a full-time, Monday-to-Friday position, with working hours from 8:30 AM to 5:30 PM (Boston time), including a one-hour lunch break.

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
Senior Backend Engineer (PHP/Laravel)


Location: Brazil



About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations. Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Senior Backend Engineer (PHP/Laravel) to join their dynamic team. This innovative company is dedicated to revolutionizing the healthcare industry through cutting-edge technology solutions.

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you will play a key role in the development and implementation of scalable and robust software solutions to support the company's mission and goals. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to design, build, and maintain innovative applications and platforms that drive business success and improve patient outcomes.


Primary Responsibilities:


  • Platform Development: Spearhead the development and optimization of our EHR platform using PHP/Laravel, ensuring high performance, reliability, and scalability.
  • Database Development: Creating database schemas that represent and support business processes
  • API Development and Integration: Develop and maintain APIs for internal and external use, facilitating seamless integration with other healthcare systems and third-party services.
  • Security Compliance: Ensure the platform's compliance with healthcare industry standards, including HIPAA, by implementing and maintaining robust security measures and data protection protocols.


Additional Responsibilities:

  • Stay abreast of new technology trends and evaluate their application to continually innovate and enhance the platform.

  • Technical Expertise: Strong proficiency in PHP/Laravel and MySQL. Familiarity with version control tools, preferably Git.
  • Experience: At least 5 years of experience in backend development, with a proven track record of developing and maintaining scalable web applications. Experience in the healthcare sector or EHR platforms is highly desirable.
  • Problem-Solving Skills: Ability to tackle complex problems, think analytically, and develop innovative solutions.
  • Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, capable of effectively collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
  • Attention to Detail: A strong focus on code quality, adherence to design specifications, and a commitment to creating a user-friendly, secure, and efficient platform.


Benefits:

  • Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: Professor de francês
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?



  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Clinical Study Manager
description:
Job Summary

The Clinical Study Manager (CSM) will be part of the Clinical Operations Department, which is responsible for planning, executing, managing and closing studies associated with the company clinical development plans. The CSM is a proven leader in clinical development with study management experience in the pharmaceutical or device industry. The CSM provides leadership and support to members of the multidisciplinary program teams, internally and externally, and can successfully thrive in a virtual clinical model. The CSM reports to the Senior Director of Clinical Operations and may be based at Liquidia’s headquarters in Research Triangle Park, North Carolina, or remote.


Specific Duties, Activities, and Responsibilities

  • Act as a patient advocate throughout the clinical development project lifecycle, with a mindset to minimize patient and site burden when participating in clinical trials.
  • Understand and support trial milestones including site identification and assessment, patient/subject recruitment, Key Opinion Leader (KOL) and Steering Committee development, and medical affairs support as required.
  • Coordinate internally with Medical and Quality Assurance to identify risks to clinical trial projects.
  • Participates in the development of study timelines, in coordination with the internal study team and external partners. Manages the trial according to agreed timelines.
  • Develop Requests for Proposals for vendors (CRO, Bioanalytical Labs, Central Safety Labs, Data Management groups, etc.) required to support clinical studies.
  • Assist or lead the vetting of vendors and sites for study participation.
  • In collaboration with Program Leaders, lead the development and updates of study specific protocols, consent forms, and other trial related materials (e.g., Study Monitoring Plan, Data Management Plans, CRFs, site training materials, Advertising Materials, etc.) as required.
  • Oversee the work of CROs and other vendors (Central Labs, Clinical Supply Distributors, etc.) as assigned to clinical trials.
  • Identifies potential risks to timelines, budgets, and quality, and participates in establishing and overseeing mitigation strategies with the internal team members and external partners, as applicable.
  • Manage and track clinical trial budgets to include forecasting, review, and approval of vendor and site payments. The CSM is also responsible for notifying management of anticipated change orders and/or budget adjustments proactively
  • Assumes primary accountability for assigned clinical trial execution according to protocol requirements, trial plans, company SOPs, ICH-GCP, FDA regulations, and applicable regulations in other regions.
  • Collaboratively work with the project team and other CRO/vendor resources and timelines associated with all study activities, including CRO/investigator agreements, central IRBs, database development and maintenance, monitoring strategy, QA audit plan, and coordination of Clinical Safety Review Teams when applicable.
  • Supports material planning and management to ensure appropriate execution of the clinical projects, including but not limited to distribution of documents, forms, supplies, equipment, and investigational product.
  • Reviews reports from study data systems which show progress of data collection, source document verification, and query resolution. Reports untimely data entry to Program lead.
  • Collaborates with Program Lead and medical monitor to ensure adverse event review and coding review occur on the timelines detailed in study plans.
  • Assists with review of study data reports during the cleaning phase of a study (i.e. prior to interim analysis or database lock) and aligns with team on any issues needing escalation.
  • Ensure the Trial Master File (TMF) is maintained and up to date and all documents are accounted for by completion of clinical study report.
  • Generate compelling periodic trial Newsletters to communicate important trial aspects to trial sites.
  • Ensure the development and maintenance of trial-specific tracking systems to enable proper study management and monitoring activities, as required
  • Work with the Senior Director of Clinical Operations, or similar to ensure that internal program team members are trained appropriately on study conduct
  • Serve as a liaison between external partners and internal team to ensure program specific information and ongoing updates are proactively communicated
  • Participates in the development, review, and implementation of departmental SOPs, processes, and initiatives.
  • Attend off-site meetings and conferences, as needed.
  • Mentorship of junior colleagues in Clinical Operations and other departments in areas of oversight to foster development and expansion of junior colleague skill sets.


Education and Experience

  • Bachelors with a minimum of five years of experience in clinical research, with at least two years of clinical project/study management.
  • Experience qualifying & managing external vendors (e.g. CRO, Call Center, Central labs, etc.).
  • Experience managing clinical project team personnel.
  • Experience leading operational teams through the start-up, study conduct, data management, and report writing of clinical studies.
  • Experience liaising cross-functional teams internally and with external partners to align on program expectations.
  • Experience reviewing and editing protocols and clinical study reports.
  • Demonstrates knowledge of Good Clinical Practices and all applicable US regulations governing clinical research, as well as working knowledge of the FDA submission process.
  • Experience in Global clinical studies and country/region specific regulations governing clinical research outside of the US.
  • Excellent organization and communication skills, including experience dealing with decision makers such as physicians and IRB members.
  • Demonstrates problem-solving and interpersonal skills.Must have a ‘can-do’ attitude and a strong desire to take ownership of many different projects.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple timelines, while maintaining the team focus.
  • Demonstrated ability to exercise judgment and determine appropriate action to a variety of problems of varying complexity.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple deadlines.


Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Strong desire to join a small company and work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to work with remote teams and to negotiate with external providers.
  • Must be detail oriented, highly organized, reliable, and accurate.
  • Must be a motivated self-starter, adaptable, and capable of working within a matrix environment.
  • Must display sound judgment and discretion as well as problem solving abilities especially within a team environment.
  • Experience with tools and systems for managing clinical rials (CTMS, TMF, EDC, ePRO database, Microsoft suite, etc.).
  • .
  • Compelling interpersonal verbal, written and presentation skills in communication with internal and external customers.
  • Must have the ability to accommodate international and domestic travel up to 30% at the request of the business.
  • Must be fluent in English

description:
About Us

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture — recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years — emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.

What It’s Like to Work at YipitData

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting — it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.

  • Ownership That Matters: You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth: We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles: Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high — always with purpose and intention

About The Role

We’re looking for a seasoned, high-output engineer who can develop our rapidly growing agent platform for our Revenue organization. This individual will sit on our Infrastructure team that builds AI-native solutions used by the entire company to find, convert, and better enable customers with the products we launch. The ideal candidate possesses 3+ years of architecting and developing full-stack applications, proficient data analytics skills, strong interest in agentic workflows, and 5+ years working on applications or codebases built with Python, Databricks, React/JavaScript/TypeScript, and AWS.

You’ll be responsible for production-grade systems that our customers and internal teams depend on daily. That means being responsive, reliable, and an excellent communicator — both when things are going well and especially when they’re not.

The ideal candidate treats AI coding tools as core infrastructure for how they work — not a novelty. You’ve shipped full-stack applications, you’re comfortable navigating ambiguity, and you are customer-obsessed in your approach to improving software.

As a Senior Software Engineer, You Will

  • Own features and systems end-to-end across multiple product surfaces — architecture, implementation, deployment, and iteration
  • Architect and deliver solutions for our Revenue, Revenue Operations, and Business Development teams – including data tools, applications, and agentic orchestrators
  • Serve as a subject matter expert across the whole stack, and report directly to the Chief Architect, who will provide hands-on mentorship in cutting‑edge AI-native development, big data analytics, and cloud infrastructure.
  • Collaborate closely with the Revenue organization, discovering opportunities, projects, and areas to revamp critical business processes with AI
  • Drive initiatives across teams — you’re not waiting for a PM to write a spec; you’re in the room shaping what gets built and why
  • Leverage AI tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Codex to improve personal productivity, ship trustworthy solutions faster through harness engineering, code quality, and documentation.
  • Produce clear documentation: create playbooks, docs, and training materials to institutionalize best practices.

You Are Likely To Succeed If

  • You have 5+ years of hands-on software development experience with a proven track record of shipping customer-facing applications — and the impact to show for it

title: Digital Marketing Ad Strategist
description:
The Digital Marketing Ad Strategist is a responsible for the performance, health, and scalability of paid advertising accounts across Google Ads, Meta (Facebook & Instagram), and LinkedIn Ads. This role is heavily focused on account audits, ongoing optimization, technical troubleshooting, and performance improvements.

You will analyze existing ad accounts, identify inefficiencies and technical issues, recommend and implement fixes, and ensure tracking, structure, and strategy are aligned with business objectives.


Requirements

  • In-depth knowledge of the following platforms: Google ads, Facebook Ads, Microsoft Ads
  • Detail oriented



Key Responsibilities


Account Audits & Diagnostics

 • Conduct in-depth audits of Google Ads, Meta, Microsoft, and LinkedIn Ads accounts. Experience or working knowledge across secondary platforms, including TikTok, Pinterest, Reddit, X, Snapchat, Spotify, and Amazon.

 • Identify structural issues, wasted spend, tracking gaps, and performance blockers

 • Diagnose bugs and technical issues such as:

 • Incorrect or missing conversion tracking

 • Pixel or tag misfires

 • Attribution and reporting discrepancies

 • Budget pacing and delivery issues

 • Audience overlap and campaign cannibalization

 • Document findings and deliver clear, prioritized optimization recommendations


 Optimization & Performance Management

• Continuous proactive optimization of campaigns, ad groups, keywords, audiences, bids, and creatives

 • Improve key performance metrics such as CPA, ROAS, CTR, and conversion rate

 • Manage and reallocate budgets based on performance and growth opportunities

 • Plan and execute A/B tests across targeting, creative, offers, and landing pages

 • Optimize accounts across full-funnel stages (awareness, consideration, conversion)


 Strategy & Execution

 • Translate business goals into effective paid media strategies

 • Ensure account structures align with funnel intent and buyer journeys

 • Align ad messaging with audience intent and platform best practices


 Tracking, Data & Reporting

 • Ensure accurate setup and ongoing validation of conversion tracking

 • Work with GA4, Google Tag Manager, and platform analytics to confirm data integrity

 • Analyze performance data to uncover insights, issues, and opportunities

 • Create performance reports that clearly explain results, risks, and next steps


 Process & Quality Control

• Maintain clean account structure, naming conventions, and documentation

 • Build and follow optimization and audit checklists

 • Stay current on platform updates, policy changes, and best practices

 • Proactively flag risks, inefficiencies, or declining performance trends


Additional Tasks

 • Forecasts and initial ad spend recommendations to assist with the Sales team.

 • Have basic design knowledge and be able to coordinate ad copy and creative with internal team members.


Language Requirements

 • Fluent in English and Portuguese


Salary

$3000 BRL (Brazilian Real) / Per Month to start

Benefits after 6 months

Initial Interview with small knowledge test

Second interview with Ads team

title: Clinical Study Manager
description:
Job Summary

The Clinical Study Manager (CSM) will be part of the Clinical Operations Department, which is responsible for planning, executing, managing and closing studies associated with the company clinical development plans. The CSM is a proven leader in clinical development with study management experience in the pharmaceutical or device industry. The CSM provides leadership and support to members of the multidisciplinary program teams, internally and externally, and can successfully thrive in a virtual clinical model. The CSM reports to the Senior Director of Clinical Operations and may be based at Liquidia’s headquarters in Research Triangle Park, North Carolina, or remote.


Specific Duties, Activities, and Responsibilities

  • Act as a patient advocate throughout the clinical development project lifecycle, with a mindset to minimize patient and site burden when participating in clinical trials.
  • Understand and support trial milestones including site identification and assessment, patient/subject recruitment, Key Opinion Leader (KOL) and Steering Committee development, and medical affairs support as required.
  • Coordinate internally with Medical and Quality Assurance to identify risks to clinical trial projects.
  • Participates in the development of study timelines, in coordination with the internal study team and external partners. Manages the trial according to agreed timelines.
  • Develop Requests for Proposals for vendors (CRO, Bioanalytical Labs, Central Safety Labs, Data Management groups, etc.) required to support clinical studies.
  • Assist or lead the vetting of vendors and sites for study participation.
  • In collaboration with Program Leaders, lead the development and updates of study specific protocols, consent forms, and other trial related materials (e.g., Study Monitoring Plan, Data Management Plans, CRFs, site training materials, Advertising Materials, etc.) as required.
  • Oversee the work of CROs and other vendors (Central Labs, Clinical Supply Distributors, etc.) as assigned to clinical trials.
  • Identifies potential risks to timelines, budgets, and quality, and participates in establishing and overseeing mitigation strategies with the internal team members and external partners, as applicable.
  • Manage and track clinical trial budgets to include forecasting, review, and approval of vendor and site payments. The CSM is also responsible for notifying management of anticipated change orders and/or budget adjustments proactively
  • Assumes primary accountability for assigned clinical trial execution according to protocol requirements, trial plans, company SOPs, ICH-GCP, FDA regulations, and applicable regulations in other regions.
  • Collaboratively work with the project team and other CRO/vendor resources and timelines associated with all study activities, including CRO/investigator agreements, central IRBs, database development and maintenance, monitoring strategy, QA audit plan, and coordination of Clinical Safety Review Teams when applicable.
  • Supports material planning and management to ensure appropriate execution of the clinical projects, including but not limited to distribution of documents, forms, supplies, equipment, and investigational product.
  • Reviews reports from study data systems which show progress of data collection, source document verification, and query resolution. Reports untimely data entry to Program lead.
  • Collaborates with Program Lead and medical monitor to ensure adverse event review and coding review occur on the timelines detailed in study plans.
  • Assists with review of study data reports during the cleaning phase of a study (i.e. prior to interim analysis or database lock) and aligns with team on any issues needing escalation.
  • Ensure the Trial Master File (TMF) is maintained and up to date and all documents are accounted for by completion of clinical study report.
  • Generate compelling periodic trial Newsletters to communicate important trial aspects to trial sites.
  • Ensure the development and maintenance of trial-specific tracking systems to enable proper study management and monitoring activities, as required
  • Work with the Senior Director of Clinical Operations, or similar to ensure that internal program team members are trained appropriately on study conduct
  • Serve as a liaison between external partners and internal team to ensure program specific information and ongoing updates are proactively communicated
  • Participates in the development, review, and implementation of departmental SOPs, processes, and initiatives.
  • Attend off-site meetings and conferences, as needed.
  • Mentorship of junior colleagues in Clinical Operations and other departments in areas of oversight to foster development and expansion of junior colleague skill sets.


Education and Experience

  • Bachelors with a minimum of five years of experience in clinical research, with at least two years of clinical project/study management.
  • Experience qualifying & managing external vendors (e.g. CRO, Call Center, Central labs, etc.).
  • Experience managing clinical project team personnel.
  • Experience leading operational teams through the start-up, study conduct, data management, and report writing of clinical studies.
  • Experience liaising cross-functional teams internally and with external partners to align on program expectations.
  • Experience reviewing and editing protocols and clinical study reports.
  • Demonstrates knowledge of Good Clinical Practices and all applicable US regulations governing clinical research, as well as working knowledge of the FDA submission process.
  • Experience in Global clinical studies and country/region specific regulations governing clinical research outside of the US.
  • Excellent organization and communication skills, including experience dealing with decision makers such as physicians and IRB members.
  • Demonstrates problem-solving and interpersonal skills.Must have a ‘can-do’ attitude and a strong desire to take ownership of many different projects.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple timelines, while maintaining the team focus.
  • Demonstrated ability to exercise judgment and determine appropriate action to a variety of problems of varying complexity.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple deadlines.


Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Strong desire to join a small company and work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to work with remote teams and to negotiate with external providers.
  • Must be detail oriented, highly organized, reliable, and accurate.
  • Must be a motivated self-starter, adaptable, and capable of working within a matrix environment.
  • Must display sound judgment and discretion as well as problem solving abilities especially within a team environment.
  • Experience with tools and systems for managing clinical rials (CTMS, TMF, EDC, ePRO database, Microsoft suite, etc.).
  • .
  • Compelling interpersonal verbal, written and presentation skills in communication with internal and external customers.
  • Must have the ability to accommodate international and domestic travel up to 30% at the request of the business.
  • Must be fluent in English

title: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
description:
About NatureCo

NatureCo delivers nature-based solutions (NbS) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. NatureCo has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.

NatureCo is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.

We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. NatureCo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.

Role and responsibilities

The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for NatureCo’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.

The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.


Primary roles and responsibilities include:

Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management

  • Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.
  • Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.
  • Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.
  • Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation.

Eligibility, due diligence & agreements

  • Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).
  • Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation
  • Lead closure of contract signatures.
  • Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within NatureCo’s data management system

(land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).

Reforestation delivery enablement

  • Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).
  • Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.
  • Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).
  • Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress).

Stakeholder engagement and safeguards

  • Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with NatureCo policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).
  • Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the NatureCo grievance mechanism.
  • Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.
  • Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required.

Reporting

  • Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.
  • Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.

Teamwork and culture

  • Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.
  • Stay current on emerging best practices in NbS and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.


Skills and attributes

To perform successfully in this role, you will have:

  • A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.
  • Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.
  • Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.
  • Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.
  • A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.
  • A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners
  • Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.
  • Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.
  • A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.


Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.


Location

  • Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia


Submission instructions

  • Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
  • Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

title: Ruby on Rails Developer
description:
Senior Software Engineer I, L3 Messaging Team (Remote)

We're recruiting a Senior Software Engineer I to own the technical direction of a mission-critical messaging platform serving hundreds of healthcare organizations across the United States.


THE ROLE

Our client is a fast-growing, mission-driven organization transforming patient engagement at scale. They've built the leading platform powering communications for underserved populations, with proven impact reaching millions. Now they're looking for a seasoned backend engineer to lead their Messaging Team technical direction and mentor the next generation of engineering talent.


You'll own complex features end-to-end, drive architectural decisions that shape how millions of patient communications are delivered, and share team lead responsibilities with your peers. This is a highly visible, technically autonomous role with direct impact on health equity outcomes.


WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 5+ years hands-on backend engineering with Ruby on Rails at scale
  • Deep experience building, maintaining, and scaling APIs and distributed systems
  • Advanced SQL skills and comfort working with large, complex datasets
  • Proven ability to independently own complex projects end-to-end and mentor junior engineers
  • Data-driven mindset you rely on evidence, not intuition
  • Excellent communicator (especially in fully remote environments)
  • Passionate about mission-driven work and advancing health equity


BONUS POINTS

  • Experience with Twilio, RCS, or MMS messaging platforms
  • Familiarity with healthcare compliance (TCPA, consent workflows, carrier regulations)
  • Tech stack: React, PostgreSQL, Google Cloud, Sidekiq
  • Event-driven architecture or high-throughput message delivery pipelines


WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own and drive the technical direction of key messaging platform features
  • Design and build backend messaging systems (delivery pipelines, consent management, scheduling orchestration, API integrations)
  • Mentor L2 engineers, lead technical design discussions, and set engineering standards
  • Contribute to architectural decisions that shape messaging infrastructure at scale
  • Participate in on-call rotations (PagerDuty) and help improve team processes
  • Work cross-functionally with Product, Customer Success, and Data teams


YOUR IMPACT

  • Month 1: Master the platform architecture and contribute to technical design discussions
  • Month 3: Independently deliver complex features with meaningful impact on patient outcomes
  • Month 6: Be recognized as a technical leader driving strategic initiatives across the engineering department

title: Data Project Manager (remote)
description:
A Brunel está apoiando uma empresa referência em soluções de dados e analytics na busca por um(a) Gerente de Projetos de Dados .


Essa pessoa terá um papel estratégico na condução de iniciativas end-to-end — desde a fase de discovery até o go-live — atuando como ponte entre áreas técnicas e de negócio. O desafio envolve liderar projetos complexos de dados, garantindo entregas de alta qualidade, dentro do prazo e alinhadas aos objetivos da organização.


Buscamos um perfil que una forte experiência em gestão de projetos com repertório técnico em dados, capaz de navegar com autonomia entre stakeholders, engenharia e decisões de arquitetura.


Principais responsabilidades

  • Liderar projetos de dados de média e alta complexidade (data warehouse, data lake, ETL/ELT, BI, migração de dados, entre outros).
  • Definir e gerenciar escopo, cronograma, orçamento, recursos e riscos.
  • Conduzir cerimônias ágeis (dailies, sprints, retrospectivas) e adaptar frameworks (Scrum, Kanban, híbrido) conforme o contexto.
  • Atuar como interface entre times técnicos e áreas de negócio, traduzindo demandas em planos de execução claros.
  • Monitorar KPIs de projeto (velocity, burn-down, progresso) e comunicar status para diferentes níveis da organização.
  • Antecipar riscos, dependências e gargalos, propondo planos de mitigação.
  • Gerenciar fornecedores e parceiros envolvidos nas entregas.
  • Garantir documentação estruturada de processos, decisões e aprendizados.
  • Impulsionar melhoria contínua nas práticas de gestão de projetos da área de dados.


Requisitos

  • Experiência consolidada (5+ anos) em gestão de projetos de tecnologia, sendo ao menos 2 anos em projetos de dados ou analytics.
  • Conhecimento prático do ecossistema de dados: data warehouse, data lake, ETL/ELT, modelagem de dados e ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Qlik, Tableau ou similares).
  • Domínio de metodologias ágeis e tradicionais (Scrum, Kanban, PMBOK/Waterfall), com flexibilidade de aplicação.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de gestão (Jira, Azure DevOps, Monday, Asana ou similares).
  • Forte habilidade de gestão de stakeholders e comunicação executiva.
  • Capacidade de interpretar documentação técnica (arquitetura, modelos de dados, integrações).
  • Inglês fluente (interação constante com times e stakeholders internacionais).


Diferenciais

  • Background técnico prévio (Data Analyst, Data Engineer ou BI Developer).
  • Experiência com cloud (Azure, AWS ou GCP).
  • Uso de soluções de IA como aceleradores de entrega.
  • Conhecimento em SQL para validações básicas.
  • Vivência com change management em contextos data-driven.
  • Conhecimento em governança de dados (ex: DAMA-DMBOK).
  • Certificações (PMP, PMI-ACP, CSM, PSM, SAFe ou similares).
  • Experiência com gestão de portfólio e priorização estratégica.

title: Business Analyst
description:
The Business Analyst will work closely with the Product Owner on a daily basis, supporting the structuring, detailing, and communication of requirements and serving as an extension of the PO within the squad. This professional will help translate business needs into clear, actionable backlog items and ensure alignment between stakeholders and the delivery team.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the right hand of the Product Owner, providing continuous support in backlog management and requirement definition.
  • Support the PO in the creation, refinement, and maintenance of Epics, User Stories, Tasks, and Acceptance Criteria, ensuring clarity and business value.
  • Prepare and support backlog refinement sessions, ensuring stories are well‑defined, estimated, prioritized, and ready for development.
  • Serve as a key point of support for the squad to clarify requirements, scope, and dependencies on behalf of the PO.
  • Manage and maintain artifacts using JIRA (backlog, stories, tasks, progress tracking) and Confluence (documentation, specifications, and decisions).
  • Support Agile ceremonies such as Sprint Planning, Daily Scrums, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives.
  • Lead Agile ceremonies when necessary, especially in the PO’s absence or when additional facilitation is required.
  • Ensure alignment between business expectations and the squad’s delivery capabilities.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Proven experience as a Business Analyst supporting Product Owners in Agile/Scrum environments.
  • Strong expertise in writing and refining Epics, User Stories, Tasks, and Acceptance Criteria.
  • Hands‑on experience with JIRA and Confluence.
  • Solid understanding of Agile principles and frameworks (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Strong facilitation, communication, and stakeholder‑management skills.
  • Ability to act autonomously as PO support while maintaining close alignment with the Product Owner.
  • Detail‑oriented, proactive, and delivery‑focused mindset.

Nice to Have

  • Experience acting as a proxy or delegate for the Product Owner.
  • Experience supporting cross‑functional or distributed Agile teams.

title: Solution Consultant
description:
Employment Type: Full-time position employed by a partner agency (3rd party, B2B)


About Sisense

Sisense is a leading AI-powered Analytics Platform as a Service (AnPaaS) that empowers product teams and developers to embed conversational, predictive, and agentic intelligence directly into applications and workflows. Our API-first, developer-first platform turns complex data into faster, smarter, actionable decisions for over 2,000 global customers across financial services, retail, healthcare, and technology.

With the recent launch of Sisense Intelligence, including the Intelligence Assistant (natural-language analytics creation), Model Context Protocol (MCP) server (secure external LLM integration), and Managed LLM capabilities, we're accelerating innovation in embedded analytics, enabling governed, scalable AI experiences at enterprise scale.


The Role

As a Solution Consultant on our Field Engineering team, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor to strategic customers, guiding them through complex analytics and data initiatives to achieve measurable business outcomes. You will lead technical discovery, design best-practice solution architectures, and partner closely with customers and internal teams to ensure successful, scalable deployments across cloud-native and embedded environments.


Why Join Our Field Engineering Services Team

You’ll operate at the intersection of customer success, product innovation, and business impact. This role gives you direct influence over high-value implementations, the opportunity to shape product direction through customer insights, and the chance to work on cutting-edge AI-embedded analytics projects with global enterprises. You’ll collaborate with diverse teams while driving real value for customers and contributing to Sisense’s growth.


Responsibilities

  • Partner directly with customers to accelerate analytics initiatives, recommend scalable architectures, and align technical solutions with long-term business goals.
  • Lead deep technical discovery sessions to understand customer data maturity, use cases, and operational constraints.
  • Own the technical customer relationship as a trusted advisor, guiding solution design across cloud-native, embedded, and secure analytics environments.
  • Design, review, and optimize data models, queries, and analytical workflows to support performant, scalable solutions.
  • Deliver onboarding sessions, solution walkthroughs, and enablement workshops tailored to customers with intermediate to advanced data and analytics maturity.
  • Create and deliver customized technical presentations and demonstrations for audiences ranging from hands-on practitioners to executive stakeholders.
  • Provide guidance on authentication, security, and access control concepts, including SSO patterns and user-level data access strategies.
  • Consult on embedding analytics into applications, including session handling and integration best practices.
  • Support solution reviews, migrations, upgrades, and architectural optimizations across customer environments.
  • Assist customers with platform administration and configuration tasks, including API automation and environment setup.
  • Collaborate closely with internal engineering, product, and support teams to surface customer feedback, identify issues, and influence future enhancements.
  • Capture and share best practices, reference architectures, and technical assets to scale knowledge across customers and internal teams.
  • Evangelize Sisense best practices through workshops, community engagement, and technical thought leadership.


About You

  • 3-5+ years of experience in a technical, customer-facing role (e.g., Solution Consultant, Pre-Sales Engineer, Technical Consultant, Implementation Specialist, or similar).
  • Hands-on experience with modern BI and analytics platforms (Sisense preferred; Tableau, Looker, Power BI, or similar acceptable).
  • Proven success leading or contributing to complex BI, cloud, or data platform implementations, from discovery through delivery.
  • Strong data modeling expertise within a BI context, including dimensional modeling and working with large, complex datasets.
  • SQL proficiency: understands join types, normalization - has the ability to join data across disparate sources, optimize queries, and design efficient analytical models.
  • Experience designing and delivering customized technical presentations and product demonstrations for audiences ranging from hands-on practitioners to executive stakeholders.
  • Ability to translate technical concepts into clear business value, adapting communication style to technical and non-technical audiences alike.
  • Solid technical foundation, including experience with:
  • JavaScript, HTML/CSS (nice to have; strong preference for hands-on exposure)
  • REST APIs and platform integrations
  • Linux-based environments and containerized architectures (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Experience providing guidance on authentication and security, including implementing or supporting SSO solutions (SAML 2.0, OIDC, JWT).
  • Detailed understanding of analytics embedding, including hands-on implementation using iFrames and related integration patterns.
  • Working knowledge of ETL methodologies, data pipelines, and upstream data preparation concepts.
  • Nice to have: prior experience with technical project management or leading workstreams across cross-functional teams.


What We Offer

  • Employment through a partner agency (B2B).
  • Competitive base salary up to USD 4300 per month (depending on experience).
  • Opportunity to work with a global leader in AI-powered embedded analytics.
  • Flexible remote work with a collaborative international team.
  • Professional development and growth opportunities.

title: Engenheiro de processos sênior
description:
A Borborema Recursos Estratégicos é uma empresa brasileira que nasceu para transformar possibilidades em realidade. Desde 2021, atuamos na Bahia com foco em pesquisa mineral de terras raras, minerais essenciais para tecnologias modernas e para a transição energética.

Nosso objetivo é unir inovação, responsabilidade e eficiência para construir um futuro sustentável. Somos subsidiárias da Brazilian Rare Earths e trabalhamos para posicionar o Brasil como protagonista no setor.


MISSÃO DO CARGO:

Desenvolver estudos e análises complexas, relacionados às atividades no campo da engenharia de processos, respondendo por identificar e quantificar recursos minerais, desenvolvendo projetos de beneficiamento de minérios e metalurgia de terras raras e elementos estratégicos, por meio da realização de estudos técnicos e análises críticas de processos, para viabilizar a produção sustentável de minérios e compostos metálicos com abrangência em toda a operação da empresa, e garantir implementação de melhorias em processos e novas tecnologias.


RESPONSABILIDADES DO CARGO

Suportar as atividades de pesquisa e desenvolvimento de rotas de processo de beneficiamento mineral e metalurgia aplicáveis ao processo de produção de elementos de terras raras e minerais estratégicos em escala de bancada, piloto e industrial, visando otimização e inovação.


Acompanhar a realização de testes metalúrgicos de beneficiamento mineral ou metalurgia em laboratórios internos, externos e Centros de Pesquisa, garantindo a qualidade dos processos e atendendo às demandas de P&D da empresa.


Revisar documentação de projetos de beneficiamento mineral e metalurgia nas diversas fases (Scoping Study até Feasibility Study), apoiando na elaboração e revisão de fluxogramas de processo e engenharia, com o objetivo de assegurar a precisão técnica dos estudos.


Atuar de forma consultiva juntamente ao corpo técnico, direcionando na elaboração e execução de programas de testes metalúrgicos e na avaliação e consolidação de informações de processos, contribuindo para a eficiência operacional.


Elaborar e revisar relatórios e apresentações para suportar as decisões da Gerência de Processos e P&D, comunicando os resultados de forma clara e objetiva para a tomada de decisões estratégicas.


Apoiar a equipe de Engenharia, Engenharia de Minas e PMO nos estudos da disciplina de Processos para planta de beneficiamento mineral e hidrometalurgia, fornecendo suporte técnico e contribuindo para a resolução de problemas.


Cumprir e fazer cumprir as normas e metas de Saúde, Segurança e Meio Ambiente, promovendo uma cultura organizacional de responsabilidade e prevenção.


Participar ativamente na formação e desenvolvimento da equipe técnica, disseminando conhecimentos e melhorando as competências do time em processos de beneficiamento mineral.


REQUISITOS DO CARGO

Formação Acadêmica: Graduação em Engenharia de Minas, Engenharia Química, Engenharia Metalúrgica e outras afins.


Idioma: Inglês Intermediário/Avançado


Disponibilidade para residir em Salvador/BA ou Lauro de Freitas/BA.

Disponibilidade para atuar eventualmente em regime de turno.


Competências Técnicas: Sólidos conhecimentos em processos metalúrgicos, beneficiamento mineral, elaboração de estudos de viabilidade, gerenciamento de projetos e domínio de softwares de modelagem de processos.


COMPETÊNCIAS COMPORTAMENTAIS

Proatividade, orientação para resultados, habilidades de comunicação, trabalho em equipe, capacidade de análise crítica, resolução de problemas complexos, flexibilidade e espírito inovador.

title: Senior Salesforce Developer
description:
Senior Salesforce Developer

Brazil


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Senior Salesforce Developer with Data Cloud experience to support a strategic initiative focused on reducing customer churn by integrating and enriching customer data across multiple platforms. This role will work closely with the Salesforce Architect, data engineering teams, and cross-functional partners to ingest, unify, and expose data within Salesforce CRM and Salesforce Data 360 (Data Cloud).

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Lead end-to-end ingestion and mapping of customer data from Salesforce CRM, Siebel, Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, and churn model outputs into Salesforce Data 360;
  • Design, build, and maintain identity and account unification rules to produce accurate customer matching and golden records;
  • Create scalable, repeatable pipelines for ingestion, transformation, mapping, and controlled promotion across environments (including Data 360 data kits);
  • Enrich Salesforce CRM records with Data 360 attributes and analytics/model insights (e.g., churn) using related lists, dynamic related lists, and custom UI components;
  • Support CRM data strategy during the Siebel-to-Salesforce migration, prioritizing Salesforce CRM as the system of engagement as adoption increases;
  • Develop and support APIs and integration services for secure internal consumption of Data 360 and CRM data; partner with architecture/engineering on integration patterns and implement ETL when native connectors don’t meet requirements;
  • Monitor and optimize Data 360 credit consumption to balance cost, performance, and SLAs;
  • Enable business teams to use enriched customer data for segmentation, activation, and analytics use cases;
  • Document processes, standards, and runbooks; contribute to shared enablement resources to drive adoption and operational continuity.

Essential Skills

  • Experience with Salesforce development;
  • Strong proficiency in: Apex, SOQL/SOSL, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Salesforce core data model, Salesforce APIs (REST/SOAP/Bulk), and integration design patterns;
  • Hands-on experience with Data ingestion and harmonization, Identity resolution and unification rules, Data kits and environment promotion, Large-scale data processing;
  • Experience connecting Salesforce Data Cloud/Data 360 to external systems (Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, Siebel, or similar), including when to use native connectors vs. custom integrations;
  • Experience with ETL processes and/or tools (e.g., Informatica, MuleSoft, Talend, Databricks);
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams;
  • Strong technical communication skills, able to translate complex concepts for architects, engineers, business users, and leadership;
  • Advanced English to be in contact with customer representative on a daily basis.

Highly Desirable Skills

  • Experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud, especially data activation and segmentation;
  • Experience with Siebel CRM integration and/or data migration;
  • Knowledge of telecom customer data, churn analytics, or Customer 360 implementations;
  • Familiarity with Azure data engineering and Microsoft Fabric connector limitations;
  • Understanding of scalable deployment pipelines and DevOps tooling (Git, CI/CD).

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

description:
About us

Carepod is a growing e-commerce brand focused on delivering a great customer experience at every step. We believe support should be fast, accurate, human, and scalable. We use AI to help our team work smarter, but we still care deeply about quality, clarity, and trust.


About the role

We are hiring a CX AI & Knowledge Manager to own the systems behind great support.

This person will manage our customer-facing knowledge, train and improve Gorgias AI , review and QA AI responses, keep our FAQ and help center up to date, and help train our team on the right processes and information.

You will be the person making sure our customers get accurate answers, our AI gets smarter over time, and our support team has the tools and guidance they need to do great work.


What you’ll own
  • Own and maintain the source of truth for support knowledge, product information, policies, and FAQs
  • Train, test, and improve Gorgias AI so responses are accurate, helpful, and on-brand
  • Review AI-generated customer responses and build a QA process to catch issues early
  • Update help center articles, FAQs, macros, and internal SOPs as products and policies change
  • Work with CX, product, operations, and marketing teams to keep information consistent across channels
  • Help onboard and train support team members on tools, workflows, and knowledge resources
  • Identify repeated support issues and fix the root cause through better documentation, automation, or training
  • Track key metrics tied to AI quality, knowledge coverage, support accuracy, and team enablement


What success looks like in the first 90 days
  • Audit our current help center, macros, and Gorgias AI setup
  • Clean up the biggest knowledge gaps affecting customers and support agents
  • Improve AI response quality for our most common support questions
  • Launch a simple QA process for AI responses
  • Create a repeatable system for updating customer-facing and internal knowledge when the business changes
  • Make it easier for team members to find the right answer fast


What we’re looking for
  • 3+ years in customer experience, CX operations, knowledge management, support enablement, or a similar role
  • Hands-on experience with Gorgias, Zendesk, Intercom, or another support platform
  • Strong writing and editing skills
  • Experience building or maintaining a help center, FAQ library, or internal knowledge base
  • Comfortable reviewing support conversations and turning patterns into process improvements
  • Strong project management and cross-functional communication skills
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to turn messy information into clear guidance
  • Able to train people, not just tools


Bonus points
  • Experience in e-commerce, especially Shopify brands
  • Experience with AI support tools, automation, and QA workflows
  • Experience writing SOPs, training materials, or internal playbooks
  • Familiarity with product catalogs, product information, or merchandising workflows


Why this role matters

This role sits at the center of customer truth. When done well, it improves customer trust, reduces mistakes, helps the support team move faster, and makes AI genuinely useful.



How to apply

Please apply with your resume and a short note answering these 3 questions:

  • Tell us about a knowledge base, FAQ, or support system you improved.
  • Tell us about a time you trained or improved an AI or automation workflow.
  • How would you keep product information accurate across multiple teams?
